place.zh: 云南禄劝皎平渡（金沙江南岸）
place.en: Jiaopingdu, Luquan, Yunnan (south bank of the Jinsha River)

summary.zh: 皎平渡是中央红军主力渡金沙江的主渡口，6 条木船、37 名船工昼夜摆渡 7 天 7 夜。
summary.en: Jiaopingdu was the main crossing of the Jinsha River for the Central Red Army, where six boats and 37 boatmen ferried troops for seven days and nights.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 3 日黄昏，刘伯承率军委干部团先遣队抢占皎平渡南岸，夺得木船 2 只，夜渡控制北岸中武山渡口。随后红军又找到 4 只船，共 6 只，并动员 37 名船工，在刘伯承、陈云分任司令员、政委的渡江指挥部统一调度下，按《渡江守则》编队编号、昼夜摆渡。至 5 月 9 日，中央红军主力 3 万余人全部由此过江。本坐标为皎平渡渡口代表点，南岸起渡点与北岸红军洞待实测。
description.en: At dusk on 3 May 1935, Liu Bocheng led the advance detachment of the Central Military Commission Cadre Regiment to seize the south bank at Jiaopingdu, captured two boats, and crossed at night to control the Zhongwushan landing on the north bank. The Red Army found four more boats, six in total, and mobilized 37 boatmen. Under the crossing command headed by Liu Bocheng and Chen Yun, and the “Crossing Rules”, the boats were numbered and ferried day and night. By 9 May more than 30,000 troops of the main force had crossed. The coordinate is a representative point at Jiaopingdu; the south-bank launching point and the north-bank Red Army cave await verification.

place.zh: 云南元谋江边乡龙街村金沙江渡口

summary.zh: 红一军团在龙街渡佯渡未成，牵制敌军后转赴皎平渡。
summary.en: The First Army Corps failed to cross at Longjie Ferry, but its feint pinned enemy forces before it shifted to Jiaopingdu.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 3 日，红一军团先头部队到达元谋龙街渡，渡船已被敌军毁坏；红军在花石滩架设浮桥，因江宽流急、敌机轰炸未成。红军以少量部队继续架桥佯渡，吸引国民党军主力向元谋方向集中，掩护主力从皎平渡渡江。5 月 5 日，红一军团奉命顺江而下，转赴皎平渡。本坐标为龙街渡代表点。
description.en: On 3 May 1935, the advance guard of the First Army Corps reached Longjie Ferry in Yuanmou, but the enemy had destroyed the boats. An attempt to build a pontoon bridge at Huashitan failed because of the wide, swift river and enemy air attacks. A small force continued the bridge feint, drawing KMT forces toward Yuanmou and covering the main crossing at Jiaopingdu. On 5 May the First Army Corps was ordered downstream to Jiaopingdu. The coordinate is a representative point at Longjie Ferry.

place.zh: 云南禄劝石板河小庙垭口一带
place.en: Xiaomiao pass area, Shibanhe, Luquan, Yunnan

summary.zh: 红五军团在石板河阻击国民党军 7 昼夜，掩护主力渡江。
summary.en: The Fifth Army Corps blocked KMT forces at Shibanhe for seven days and nights, covering the main force’s crossing.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 3 日，红五军团奉命在禄劝石板河一线构筑阵地，阻击尾追的国民党军万耀煌第 13 师等部，掩护中央纵队从皎平渡渡江。红军依托小庙垭口等险要地形，坚守 7 昼夜，打退敌军多次进攻；5 月 9 日完成掩护任务后，撤出阵地，急行军至皎平渡过江。本坐标为石板河/小庙垭口代表点，具体战壕与阵地待实测。
description.en: On 3 May 1935, the Fifth Army Corps was ordered to build positions at Shibanhe in Luquan to block the pursuing KMT 13th Division under Wan Yaohuang and cover the central column’s crossing at Jiaopingdu. Holding strong points such as the Xiaomiao pass, the corps resisted for seven days and nights and repulsed repeated attacks. On 9 May, after completing the mission, it withdrew and marched rapidly to Jiaopingdu to cross. The coordinate is a representative point at Shibanhe/Xiaomiao pass; the trenches and positions await verification.

summary.zh: 军委干部团夺取通安，打开皎平渡北岸的前进通道。
summary.en: The CMC Cadre Regiment seized Tongan, opening the advance route north of Jiaopingdu.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 3 日至 4 日，军委干部团在陈赓、宋任穷率领下渡过金沙江，向通安推进，击溃川军刘元瑭部，占领通安镇，保障了皎平渡渡口北岸的安全。通安是皎平渡通往会理的要道。本坐标为通安镇代表点，具体战斗阵地待考。
description.en: On 3–4 May 1935, the CMC Cadre Regiment under Chen Geng and Song Renqiong crossed the Jinsha River and advanced on Tongan, routing Liu Yuantang’s Sichuan troops and seizing the town, securing the north bank at Jiaopingdu. Tongan was the key route from Jiaopingdu to Huili. The coordinate is a representative point for Tongan; the exact positions await verification.

place.zh: 云南禄劝洪门渡（北岸为四川会东可河）
place.en: Hongmen Ferry, Luquan, Yunnan (Kehe, Huidong, Sichuan on the north bank)

summary.zh: 红三军团在洪门渡架桥未成，仅红十三团由一只木船渡过，主力转赴皎平渡。
summary.en: The Third Army Corps failed to bridge the Hongmen Ferry; only the 13th Regiment crossed by a single boat, and the main force shifted to Jiaopingdu.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 3 日，红三军团先头部队到达禄劝洪门渡，江面不宽但水流湍急，架设浮桥被冲毁。红军找到一只小木船，在船工帮助下昼夜摆渡，仅红十三团渡过金沙江，占领北岸可河街。5 月 5 日，红三军团主力奉命逆江而上，转赴皎平渡。本坐标为洪门渡/可河渡口代表点。
description.en: On 3 May 1935, the advance guard of the Third Army Corps reached Hongmen Ferry in Luquan. The river was narrow but swift, and the pontoon bridge was swept away. The Red Army found a small boat and, with local boatmen, ferried the 13th Regiment across to seize Kehe Street on the north bank. On 5 May the main force was ordered upstream to Jiaopingdu. The coordinate is a representative point at the Hongmen/Kehe ferry.

place.zh: 云南东川拖布卡镇树桔村金沙江渡口

summary.zh: 红九军团从树桔渡渡过金沙江，完成侧翼牵制任务。
summary.en: The Ninth Army Corps crossed the Jinsha River at Shuju Ferry, completing its flanking and diversion task.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 4 日，红九军团先头部队到达东川树桔渡，在船工帮助下打捞修补一只沉船，连夜摆渡 13 次，将 200 余人送过江。随后红军夺取北岸汪家坪盐场，打捞被封沉的盐船，5 月 5 日至 6 日全军团 3400 余人由树桔渡渡过金沙江。本坐标为树桔渡代表点，渡江指挥所旧址在白鹤滩蓄水前位于树桔村田尾巴。
description.en: On 4 May 1935, the advance guard of the Ninth Army Corps reached Shuju Ferry in Dongchuan. With local boatmen they raised and repaired a sunken boat and ferried more than 200 men across in 13 trips overnight. The Red Army then seized the Wangjiaping salt works on the north bank and recovered the sunken salt boats; on 5–6 May the entire corps of more than 3,400 crossed at Shuju. The coordinate is a representative point at Shuju Ferry; the crossing command site stood at Tianweiba, Shuju Village, before the Baihetan reservoir.

aliases.en: Red Army Cave on the North Bank

place.zh: 云南禄劝皎平渡北岸岩洞（今属四川会理中武山）
place.en: Cave on the north bank at Jiaopingdu (now Zhongwushan, Huili, Sichuan)

summary.zh: 红军在皎平渡北岸岩洞设立渡江指挥部，统一调度全军渡江。
summary.en: The Red Army set up a crossing command in a cave on the north bank at Jiaopingdu to coordinate the crossing.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 4 日，毛泽东、朱德、周恩来等率军委纵队从皎平渡过江后，在江北岸一孔天然岩洞设立渡江指挥部，由刘伯承任司令员、陈云任政委，颁布《渡江守则》，统一调度船只、船工与各部队渡江顺序。指挥部同时处理电报、筹粮与船工保障，是皎平渡 7 天 7 夜有序渡江的中枢。本坐标为北岸红军洞代表点，原洞已在乌东德水库蓄水后淹没，现为原址附近纪念点。
description.en: After Mao Zedong, Zhu De, Zhou Enlai, and the CMC column crossed at Jiaopingdu on 4 May 1935, they established a crossing command in a natural cave on the north bank. Liu Bocheng served as commander and Chen Yun as political commissar; the command issued the “Crossing Rules” and coordinated boats, boatmen, and the crossing order of each unit. It also handled telegrams, grain, and boatmen’s support, forming the hub of the seven-day crossing. The coordinate is a representative point at the north-bank Red Army cave; the original cave was submerged by the Wudongde reservoir, and a memorial now stands nearby.

summary.zh: 红三军团围攻会理城 7 天 7 夜，未克后撤围北上。
summary.en: The Third Army Corps besieged Huili for seven days and nights before withdrawing and moving north.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 8 日，红三军团到达会理城郊，夺取城东东山寺、城西南西来寺等制高点，包围会理城；9 日，军委干部团加入攻城。红军主攻北、西两面，连续攻城并挖掘坑道，14 日以棺材装火药炸开西北角城墙，守军刘元瑭部堵住缺口，红军攻城未克。7 天 7 夜后，中革军委决定停止攻城，撤围北上。本坐标为会理古城代表点，具体攻城阵地待考。
description.en: On 8 May 1935, the Third Army Corps reached the outskirts of Huili, seized the Dongshan and Xilai temples and other high ground, and encircled the city; on 9 May the CMC Cadre Regiment joined the assault. The Red Army attacked the north and west sides, dug tunnels, and on 14 May blew a breach in the northwest wall with gunpowder packed in a coffin, but Liu Yuantang’s defenders sealed it. After seven days and nights, the CMC ordered the siege lifted and the army moved north. The coordinate is a representative point for Huili old city; the exact assault positions await verification.

summary.zh: 川军刘元瑭部死守会理，烧毁城外民房、封闭城门，红军攻城未克。
summary.en: Liu Yuantang’s Sichuan troops held Huili, burning houses outside the walls and sealing the gates; the Red Army failed to take the city.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月，川军刘元瑭部（第 7 师等）防守会理城。守军为清除射界，用煤油、棉花烧毁城外北关、西关、东关民房，封闭四门，撬起街石堵塞城门，并强迫军警死守。红三军团与军委干部团围攻 7 天 7 夜，爆破西北角城墙后，刘元瑭亲自率部堵击，面部受伤，仍堵住缺口。红军撤围后，守军仍固守会理。本坐标为会理古城代表点，具体城防工事待考。
description.en: In May 1935, Liu Yuantang’s Sichuan troops (including the 7th Division) defended Huili. To clear fields of fire, they burned houses in the north, west, and east suburbs with kerosene and cotton, sealed the four gates, pried up street stones to block the gateways, and ordered the garrison to hold to the death. The Third Army Corps and the CMC Cadre Regiment besieged the city for seven days and nights; after the northwest wall was breached, Liu Yuantang personally led the counterattack, was wounded in the face, and sealed the gap. The Red Army withdrew, and the garrison held Huili. The coordinate is a representative point for the old city; the exact defenses await verification.

place.zh: 四川绵阳安州千佛山（千佛镇一带）
place.en: Qianfo Mountain, Anzhou, Mianyang, Sichuan (Qianfo township area)

summary.zh: 红四方面军攻占千佛山主峰并坚守月余，牵制川军，掩护主力西进岷江。
summary.en: The Fourth Front Army took and held the Qianfo Mountain peak for over a month, pinning Sichuan troops while the main force moved west to the Min River.

description.zh: 千佛山位于北川河谷南侧，与伏泉山、观音梁子连绵起伏百余里，是南扼川西平原、北控北川河谷的天然屏障。1935 年 5 月 10 日，红四方面军第三十军第八十八师、第九军第二十五师各一部配合已在千佛山东部的部队，对守军形成左右夹击态势，攻占千佛山主峰。此后数日，两军在大垭口、千佛山等地反复争夺，国民党军始终未能夺回阵地。6 月中旬，坚守伏泉山、千佛山、土门一线负责掩护和牵制敌军的红军部队，在红四方面军副总指挥王树声指挥下撤离阵地，跟随主力西进。千佛山一线的坚守为红四方面军主力西入岷江、迎接中央红军争取了时间，也是土门战役中持续时间最长的一段。本坐标为千佛镇一带代表点，主峰精确位置待实测。
description.en: Qianfo Mountain lies on the south side of the Beichuan valley; with Fuquan Hill and Guanyin Ridge it forms a ridge line over a hundred li long that screens the Chengdu plain to the south and commands the Beichuan valley to the north. On 10 May 1935 the 88th Division of the 30th Army and the 25th Division of the 9th Army, with the troops already east of the mountain, attacked from both sides and took the main peak. For several days afterwards the two sides fought over Dayakou and Qianfo Mountain, and the Sichuan troops never retook the positions. In mid-June the Red Army units holding the Fuquan–Qianfo–Tumen line to cover and pin the enemy withdrew under the command of Wang Shusheng, deputy commander of the Fourth Front Army, and followed the main force west. The stand at Qianfo Mountain bought time for the main force to enter the Min River basin and meet the Central Red Army, and was the longest phase of the Tumen campaign. The coordinate is a representative point in the Qianfo township area; the exact peak position remains to be surveyed.

sources.author: 人民网·党史（姜廷玉，中国人民革命军事博物馆）

place.en: Tiechang Village north of Huili, Sichuan

summary.zh: 中央政治局在会理城北铁厂村召开扩大会议，决定继续北上、抢渡大渡河。
summary.en: The Politburo held an enlarged meeting at Tiechang Village north of Huili and decided to continue north to force the Dadu River.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 12 日，中共中央政治局在会理城北铁厂村召开扩大会议，总结遵义会议以来的战略方针，批评部分同志对机动作战的怀疑，决定继续北上、越大渡河与红四方面军会合，并任命刘伯承为先遣队司令员、聂荣臻为政委。会议先在树林草棚中举行，因敌机侦察，后转移到平安寺继续。与会人员记载略有出入，本条目只列主要人员。本坐标为铁厂村会理会议纪念地代表点。
description.en: On 12 May 1935, the CCP Politburo held an enlarged meeting at Tiechang Village north of Huili. It reviewed the strategy since the Zunyi Conference, criticized doubts about mobile warfare, decided to continue north across the Dadu River to join the Fourth Front Army, and appointed Liu Bocheng as advance detachment commander and Nie Rongzhen as political commissar. The meeting began in a makeshift shelter in the woods and moved to Ping’an Temple because of enemy air reconnaissance. Accounts of attendees differ slightly; this entry lists only the main participants. The coordinate is a representative point at the Tiechang meeting memorial site.

aliases.en: Fourth Front Army Enters Mao County

summary.zh: 红四方面军攻占茂县，以此为中心建立临时后方，为西进懋功与迎接中央红军筹粮备物。
summary.en: The Fourth Front Army took Mao county town and made it a temporary rear base, stockpiling grain and supplies for the move to Maogong and the meeting with the Central Red Army.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 15 日，红四方面军攻占土门、干沟后乘胜追击，占领茂县（今茂县凤仪镇）。茂县地处岷江上游，是川西北的交通要道与物资集散地，红军占领后以此为中心设置临时后方，医院、兵工厂、被服厂等陆续开办，并为后续西进理番、懋功和迎接中央红军筹集粮食、盐巴、药品与御寒物资。5 月 18 日国民党军以近 30 个团反扑土门，红军在大垭口重创其一个旅，茂县得以稳固；5 月 22 日蒋介石令停止进攻后，红四方面军主力继续向理番、懋功方向西进。茂县是红四方面军长征途中在川西北建立的第一个较稳定的落脚点。本坐标为茂县县城代表点。
description.en: On 15 May 1935, after taking Tumen and Gangou, the Fourth Front Army pursued and occupied Mao county town (present-day Fengyi, Mao county). Mao sits on the upper Min River and was a transport hub and supply centre in northwestern Sichuan; the Red Army made it a temporary rear base with hospitals, an arsenal, and a uniform workshop, and stockpiled grain, salt, medicine, and winter supplies for the move west to Lifan and Maogong and the meeting with the Central Red Army. On 18 May the Sichuan troops counter-attacked Tumen with nearly thirty regiments and the Red Army mauled a brigade at Dayakou, securing Mao; after Chiang Kai-shek ordered the attacks stopped on 22 May the main force continued west toward Lifan and Maogong. Mao was the first reasonably secure foothold the Fourth Front Army established in northwestern Sichuan during the Long March. The coordinate is a representative point at Mao county town.

summary.zh: 刘伯承、聂荣臻在泸沽决定走冕宁—拖乌—安顺场小路，另派红五团佯动大树堡。
summary.en: At Lugu, Liu Bocheng and Nie Rongzhen decided to take the Mianning–Tuowu–Anshunchang trail and sent the Fifth Regiment to feint at Dashubao.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 20 日晚，红军先遣队在冕宁泸沽决定改变原定经越西、大树堡的大路，改走冕宁、大桥、拖乌、彝海至安顺场的小路，以避开川军重兵；同时派左权、刘亚楼率红一军团第二师第五团等向越西、大树堡方向佯动，迷惑富林之敌。21 日，中革军委复电同意。本坐标为泸沽镇代表点。
description.en: On the night of 20 May 1935, the Red Army advance detachment at Lugu in Mianning decided to abandon the main road via Yuexi and Dashubao for the trail through Mianning, Daqiao, Tuowu, and Yihai to Anshunchang, avoiding the main Sichuan forces. At the same time, Zuo Quan and Liu Yalou led the Fifth Regiment of the Second Division toward Yuexi and Dashubao as a feint to deceive the enemy at Fulin. On 21 May the CMC approved the change. The coordinate is a representative point for Lugu.

aliases.en: Establishment of the Mianning Revolutionary Committee

summary.zh: 红军先遣队进入冕宁，释放“换班坐质”彝族首领，随后成立冕宁县革命委员会。
summary.en: The Red Army advance detachment entered Mianning, released Yi hostages held under the rotation-hostage system, and later established the Mianning Revolutionary Committee.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 21 日凌晨，刘伯承、聂荣臻率先遣队到达冕宁县城，在地下党配合下进城，释放被扣押的彝族“换班坐质”人质，焚毁强迫签署的文书，宣布废除换班坐质制度。5 月 23 日，红军在冕宁文庙召开群众大会，成立冕宁县革命委员会，陈野苹任主席、李井泉任副主席，并成立抗捐军。本坐标为冕宁县城代表点。
description.en: In the early hours of 21 May 1935, Liu Bocheng and Nie Rongzhen led the advance detachment into Mianning county town with local underground party support. They released Yi hostages held under the rotation-hostage system, burned the forced agreements, and abolished the system. On 23 May the Red Army held a mass meeting at the Mianning Confucian temple and established the Mianning County Revolutionary Committee, with Chen Yeping as chairman and Li Jingquan as vice chairman, along with an anti-tax militia. The coordinate is a representative point for the county town.

aliases.en: Alliance between Liu Bocheng and Xiaoyedan

place.zh: 四川冕宁彝海镇彝海（袁居海子）
place.en: Yihai (Yuanju Haizi), Yihai Town, Mianning, Sichuan

summary.zh: 刘伯承与彝族果基家支首领小叶丹在彝海歃血为盟，红军顺利通过彝区。
summary.en: Liu Bocheng and Xiaoyedan, leader of the Yi Guji clan, swore a blood oath at Yihai, allowing the Red Army to pass through Yi territory.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 22 日，红军先遣队在冕宁以北彝海（袁居海子）与彝族果基家支首领果基约达（小叶丹）歃血为盟。因无酒，刘伯承以彝海水代酒，与小叶丹饮鸡血水结为兄弟；当晚授予小叶丹“中国夷民红军沽鸡支队”队旗，并赠送枪支。小叶丹随后派向导护送红军通过拖乌彝区，为强渡大渡河赢得时间。本坐标为彝海结盟取水点附近代表点。
description.en: On 22 May 1935, the Red Army advance detachment swore a blood oath with Xiaoyedan (Guji Yueda), leader of the Yi Guji clan, at Yihai (Yuanju Haizi) north of Mianning. With no wine, Liu Bocheng used water from Yihai and drank chicken blood with Xiaoyedan as brothers. That evening he gave Xiaoyedan the banner of the “Chinese Yi Red Army Guji Detachment” and presented rifles. Xiaoyedan then sent guides to escort the Red Army through Tuowu Yi territory, gaining time for the Dadu River crossing. The coordinate is a representative point near the oath-taking site at Yihai.

place.zh: 四川汉源大树堡（今大树镇）

summary.zh: 红一军团第二师第五团等佯攻大树堡，牵制富林川军，掩护安顺场主渡。
summary.en: The Fifth Regiment of the Second Division and other units feinted at Dashubao, pinning Sichuan troops at Fulin and covering the main crossing at Anshunchang.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 20 日夜，红一军团参谋长左权、第二师政委刘亚楼率第二师第五团等由泸沽分兵，经越西、海棠向大树堡挺进；23 日占领大树堡，24 日至 25 日在大渡河南岸大张旗鼓造船、扎筏、架线，制造由大树堡渡河攻打富林、雅安、成都的假象。北岸川军急调兵力增援富林，放松了安顺场至泸定一线的防守。26 日红五团奉命撤离大树堡，绕道返回安顺场。本坐标为大树堡镇代表点，渡口具体位置待实测。
description.en: On the night of 20 May 1935, Zuo Quan, chief of staff of the First Army Corps, and Liu Yalou, political commissar of the Second Division, led the Fifth Regiment and other units from Lugu via Yuexi and Haitang toward Dashubao. They took Dashubao on 23 May and on 24–25 May ostentatiously built boats and rafts and laid telephone lines on the south bank, creating the impression that the main force would cross at Dashubao and drive on Fulin, Ya’an, and Chengdu. Sichuan troops rushed reinforcements to Fulin, weakening the Anshunchang–Luding sector. On 26 May the Fifth Regiment withdrew and returned to Anshunchang. The coordinate is a representative point for Dashubao; the exact ferry site awaits verification.

aliases.zh: 强渡大渡河与飞夺泸定桥
aliases.en: Forcing the Dadu and Seizing Luding Bridge

place.zh: 四川石棉安顺场（战役范围含大树堡、磨西、泸定桥）
place.en: Anshunchang, Shimian, Sichuan (the campaign spanned Dashubao, Moxi, and Luding Bridge)

summary.zh: 中央红军在安顺场强渡大渡河、飞夺泸定桥，粉碎川军围堵，打开北上通道。
summary.en: The Central Red Army forced the Dadu River at Anshunchang and seized Luding Bridge, breaking the Sichuan army’s blockade and opening the route north.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 24 日至 29 日，中央红军先遣队夜袭安顺场，25 日十七勇士强渡大渡河；因船只不足，主力分左右两路沿大渡河两岸北上，29 日红四团夺取泸定桥，中央红军主力陆续过河。此役粉碎了蒋介石让红军成为“石达开第二”的企图，打开了北上川西的通道。战役范围含安顺场、大树堡佯动、磨西会议与泸定桥，分列独立事件。
description.en: From 24 to 29 May 1935, the Central Red Army’s advance detachment seized Anshunchang by night; on 25 May seventeen heroes forced the Dadu River. Because there were too few boats, the main force moved north along both banks, and on 29 May the Fourth Regiment seized Luding Bridge, allowing the main force to cross. The campaign foiled Chiang Kai-shek’s attempt to repeat Shi Dakai’s destruction and opened the route to western Sichuan. Anshunchang, the Dashubao feint, the Moxi meeting, and Luding Bridge are separate events.

name.en: Sichuan Army’s Anshunchang North Bank Defense

place.zh: 四川石棉安顺场大渡河北岸
place.en: North bank of the Dadu River at Anshunchang, Shimian, Sichuan

summary.zh: 川军第二十四军一部防守安顺场北岸，未能阻止红军强渡。
summary.en: A force of the Sichuan 24th Army defended the north bank at Anshunchang but failed to stop the Red Army’s crossing.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月，川军第二十四军第五旅第七团一个营防守安顺场北岸渡口，另有“彝务指挥官”邓秀廷部两个连协同。守军收缴南岸船只、在北岸修筑碉堡，并在南岸安顺场堆积柴草准备烧街。24 日夜红军袭占安顺场，守军未能及时纵火；25 日红军十七勇士强渡，赵章成炮火摧毁北岸碉堡，守军溃退。本坐标为安顺场北岸滩头代表点，具体碉堡位置待考。
description.en: In May 1935, one battalion of the 7th Regiment, 5th Brigade, Sichuan 24th Army defended the north bank at Anshunchang, with two companies under the “Yi affairs commander” Deng Xiuting. The defenders collected boats on the south bank, built blockhouses on the north bank, and piled combustibles in Anshunchang to burn the street. The Red Army seized Anshunchang on the night of 24 May before the defenders could set fires; on 25 May the seventeen heroes crossed, Zhao Zhangcheng’s shellfire destroyed the north-bank blockhouses, and the defenders fled. The coordinate is a representative point on the north bank; the exact blockhouse sites await verification.

summary.zh: 红军十七勇士在安顺场强渡大渡河，打开北上通道。
summary.en: Seventeen heroes forced the Dadu River at Anshunchang, opening the route north.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 24 日夜，红一团袭占安顺场，夺得木船一只。25 日清晨，一营营长孙继先率十七勇士分两批强渡大渡河，在赵章成炮火掩护下击溃北岸守军，占领桃子湾渡口。随后红军在安靖坝又找到两只船，77 名船工连续摆渡 7 天 7 夜，把主力送过河。安顺场由此成为长征中“翼王悲剧地、红军胜利场”的标志性渡口。本坐标为安顺场渡口代表点。
description.en: On the night of 24 May 1935, the First Regiment seized Anshunchang and captured a wooden boat. At dawn on 25 May, Sun Jixian led seventeen heroes across in two groups; covered by Zhao Zhangcheng’s artillery, they routed the north-bank defenders and took the Taozhiwan landing. Two more boats were found at Anjingba, and 77 boatmen ferried the main force for seven days and nights. Anshunchang became the emblematic crossing where the Red Army avoided Shi Dakai’s fate. The coordinate is a representative point at the ferry.

summary.zh: 国民党川军沿大渡河设防，企图阻止红军渡河北上。
summary.en: Sichuan KMT forces defended the Dadu River to block the Red Army’s crossing.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月，国民党军以川军第二十四军刘文辉部守大渡河上游，杨森第二十军等守富林至雅安一线，重点东重西轻。第二十四军第五旅第七团一个营守安顺场北岸，第四旅第三十八团两个营守泸定城与泸定桥，另有地方民团协同。红军以大树堡佯攻牵制富林方向，主力从安顺场强渡并夺取泸定桥，突破了大渡河防线。本坐标为安顺场代表点，防线范围沿大渡河展开。
description.en: In May 1935, Liu Wenhui’s Sichuan 24th Army held the upper Dadu River while Yang Sen’s 20th Army and other units held the Fulin–Ya’an sector, with the strongest defenses in the east. One battalion of the 7th Regiment, 5th Brigade, 24th Army held the north bank at Anshunchang, and two battalions of the 38th Regiment, 4th Brigade, held Luding town and bridge, supported by local militia. The Red Army feinted at Dashubao to pin forces at Fulin, then forced the river at Anshunchang and seized Luding Bridge, breaking the defense line. The coordinate is a representative point at Anshunchang; the line extended along the Dadu River.

place.zh: 四川石棉安顺场大渡河南岸
place.en: South bank of the Dadu River at Anshunchang, Shimian, Sichuan

summary.zh: 安顺场渡口是红军强渡大渡河的主要渡口，十七勇士由此登船突击。
summary.en: Anshunchang Ferry was the main crossing point of the Dadu River, from which seventeen heroes launched their assault.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 24 日夜，红一团冒雨急行军袭占安顺场，歼灭守敌两个连，夺得翘首木船一只，控制南岸渡口。25 日清晨，一营营长孙继先率十七勇士分两批从安顺场渡口登船，在轻重机枪和迫击炮掩护下强渡；赵章成以两发炮弹摧毁北岸碉堡，勇士们占领桃子湾渡口。随后 77 名船工用 3 只木船连续摆渡 7 天 7 夜，将主力送过大渡河。渡口现存“红军渡”石碑、强渡大渡河纪念碑与指挥楼。本坐标为安顺场镇渡口代表点，具体起渡点待实测。
description.en: On the night of 24 May 1935, the First Regiment seized Anshunchang, destroyed two enemy companies, captured a wooden boat, and controlled the south bank. At dawn on 25 May, Sun Jixian, commander of the 1st Battalion, led seventeen heroes across in two groups from Anshunchang Ferry under machine-gun and mortar cover; Zhao Zhangcheng knocked out the north-bank blockhouses with two shells, and the heroes took the Taozhiwan landing. Some 77 boatmen then ferried the main force across in three boats for seven days and nights. The “Red Army Crossing” stone, the memorial, and the command tower remain. The coordinate is a representative point at Anshunchang; the exact launching point awaits verification.

place.en: East bridgehead of Luding Bridge, Sichuan

summary.zh: 川军第二十四军第三十八团等防守泸定桥，抽去桥板、火烧东桥头，仍未能阻止红军夺桥。
summary.en: The 38th Regiment of the Sichuan 24th Army defended Luding Bridge, removing planks and setting fire to the east bridgehead, but failed to stop the Red Army.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 28 日，川军第二十四军第四旅第三十八团（团长李全山）第三营（营长周桂山）奉命连夜赶赴泸定，拆去泸定桥大部分桥板，在东桥头构筑机枪、迫击炮阵地，并准备煤油烧桥。29 日下午红四团发起夺桥战斗，二十二名勇士攀踏铁索冲击，守军点燃东桥头大火，红军冲过火墙，经约两小时激战占领泸定城与桥梁。本坐标为泸定桥东桥头代表点，具体阵地待实测。
description.en: On 28 May 1935, the 3rd Battalion of the 38th Regiment, 4th Brigade, Sichuan 24th Army (regimental commander Li Quanshan; battalion commander Zhou Guishan) rushed to Luding, removed most of the bridge planks, built machine-gun and mortar positions at the east bridgehead, and prepared kerosene to burn the bridge. On the afternoon of 29 May the Fourth Regiment attacked; twenty-two heroes advanced along the iron chains, the defenders set the east bridgehead ablaze, and the Red Army broke through the flames, taking Luding town and the bridge after about two hours. The coordinate is a representative point at the east bridgehead; the exact positions await verification.

summary.zh: 红军二十二勇士攀踏铁索夺取泸定桥，打开北上通道。
summary.en: Twenty-two heroes seized Luding Bridge along its iron chains, opening the route north.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 29 日，红四团在团长黄开湘（一作王开湘）、政委杨成武率领下，一昼夜急行军 240 里赶到泸定桥西桥头。下午 4 时，二连连长廖大珠率二十二名勇士攀踏被抽去桥板的十三根铁索，冒着东桥头火力冲击；守军点燃桥头大火，勇士们冲过火墙，经约两小时激战占领泸定城与桥梁。红四团伤亡 4 人，中央红军主力随后由泸定桥过大渡河。本坐标为泸定桥代表点。
description.en: On 29 May 1935, the Fourth Regiment under Huang Kaixiang (also written Wang Kaixiang) and political commissar Yang Chengwu reached the west end of Luding Bridge after a 240-li forced march in a day and night. At 4 p.m., Liao Dazhu, commander of the 2nd Company, led twenty-two heroes along the thirteen iron chains stripped of planks, under fire from the east bridgehead. The defenders set the bridgehead ablaze; the heroes charged through the flames and took Luding town and the bridge after about two hours. The Fourth Regiment suffered four casualties, and the main force crossed the Dadu River at Luding. The coordinate is a representative point at the bridge.

place.zh: 四川泸定磨西镇天主教堂

summary.zh: 毛泽东在磨西天主教堂召集会议，确定有序通过泸定桥与北上安排。
summary.en: Mao Zedong convened a meeting at the Moxi Catholic Church, deciding on the orderly crossing of Luding Bridge and the route north.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 29 日晚，毛泽东随中央军委机关抵达泸定磨西，宿营磨西天主教堂神甫楼，并召集朱德、周恩来、张闻天、王稼祥、陈云、秦邦宪等开会。会议决定红军不去康定，通知部队有序通过泸定桥、先过人后过马，派陈云出川赴上海恢复党组织并转赴苏联，同时抓紧筹粮，并准备到泸定后研究北上路线。会议日期另有 5 月 28 日说，参加人员记载亦有出入，本条目从 29 日说并只列主要与会者。5 月 30 日凌晨毛泽东离开磨西，行至摩岗岭接到红四团夺取泸定桥的捷报。
description.en: On the evening of 29 May 1935, Mao Zedong reached Moxi in Luding with the Central Military Commission office and stayed at the priest’s house of the Moxi Catholic Church. He convened Zhu De, Zhou Enlai, Zhang Wentian, Wang Jiaxiang, Chen Yun, Qin Bangxian, and others. The meeting decided not to go to Kangding; to move troops across Luding Bridge in order, men before horses; to send Chen Yun to Shanghai to restore the party organization and then to the Soviet Union; to collect grain; and to discuss the route north after reaching Luding. Some accounts date the meeting to 28 May and differ on attendees; this entry follows 29 May and lists only the main participants. Mao left Moxi before dawn on 30 May and received news of the bridge’s capture near Mogangling.

place.zh: 四川泸定兴隆镇化林坪（飞越岭西北麓）
place.en: Hualinping, Xinglong, Luding, Sichuan (northwest foot of Feiyueling)

summary.zh: 红一师由龙八铺东进，与红六团合围，攻占飞越岭下的化林坪，川军第四旅残部退往飞越岭。
summary.en: The 1st Division pushed east from Longbabu and, joining the 6th Regiment, took Hualinping below Feiyueling; the remnants of the KMT 4th Brigade fell back to the pass.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 29 日夺桥前后，右纵队红一师占领大渡河左岸的龙八铺（今泸定兴隆镇），随即东进追击川军第二十四军第四旅残部。5 月 30 日红一师占领盐水溪，川军第四旅旅长袁国瑞率旅部与第十一团残部退向化林坪、飞越岭，令第十一团残部在飞越岭东麓的三交坪整顿，自己继续向汉源方向撤退；第十团则赶至化林坪构筑工事、密布地雷。化林坪在飞越岭西北麓，东南倚山、西北绝壁，俯盐水溪，是茶马古道上的军事重镇，红一师自盐水溪仰攻屡屡受阻。红六团冒雨从泸定急行军赶来会合，与红一师兵分两路形成合围，当日攻占化林坪，守军仓皇逃往飞越岭。此战红军伤亡数字各资料记载不一，本条目不作估算。本坐标为化林坪村代表点。
description.en: Around the seizure of Luding Bridge on 29 May 1935 the right column’s 1st Division took Longbabu (present-day Xinglong, Luding) on the left bank of the Dadu and pushed east after the remnants of the KMT 24th Army’s 4th Brigade. On 30 May the 1st Division took Yanshuixi; brigade commander Yuan Guorui withdrew with his headquarters and the remains of the 11th Regiment toward Hualinping and Feiyueling, ordering the 11th Regiment’s remnants to regroup at Sanjiaoping east of the pass while he continued toward Hanyuan, and the 10th Regiment hurried to Hualinping to dig in and lay mines. Hualinping, at the northwest foot of Feiyueling, backed by mountains to the southeast and cliffs to the northwest above the Yanshuixi stream, was a military and trading town on the tea-horse road, and the 1st Division’s frontal attacks from Yanshuixi stalled repeatedly. The 6th Regiment force-marched through rain from Luding, joined the 1st Division, and the two attacked on separate axes to close a ring; Hualinping fell that day and the defenders fled to Feiyueling. Casualty figures differ across sources and are not estimated here. The coordinate is a representative point at Hualinping village.

sources.title: 《雄关漫道“飞越岭”——寻访红军突破大渡河峡谷的最后一个天险》
sources.author: 新华网
sources.note: 用于核对化林坪位于飞越岭西北麓、飞越岭为突破大渡河峡谷的最后一道天险

place.zh: 四川泸定东南飞越岭垭口（飞越关）
place.en: Feiyueling pass (Feiyue Pass), southeast of Luding, Sichuan

summary.zh: 红四团趁大雾从左翼攀援突袭，夺取飞越岭垭口，打通中央红军北上的最后一道天险。
summary.en: The 4th Regiment climbed the left flank under cover of fog and stormed the Feiyueling pass, opening the last natural barrier on the road north.

description.zh: 飞越岭又称大垭口，位于泸定县东南，岭上垭口名飞越关，南北两侧矗立海拔 3000 米以上的山峰，双峰对峙形成天然隘口，是内地通往康藏的咽喉，也是中央红军突破大渡河峡谷、北上与红四方面军会师的最后一道天险。1935 年 5 月 31 日，川军残部在通向山顶的羊肠小道上埋设地雷，凭险据守，红军进攻受阻，两军在飞越岭半坡僵持。当日晨，红二师师长陈光、师政委刘亚楼，红四团团长黄开湘（一作王开湘）、团政委杨成武到山脚勘察，决定利用山间多雾的特点，由第二营副营长黄霖率第六连及一个机枪排从左翼山峰迂回攀援。部队沿狭窄山道攀登，半山以上云雾弥漫，一阵劲风吹散雾气，露出险峻山峰，黄霖判定此处为敌人疏于戒备的侧翼，当即借云雾掩护突袭，夺取垭口，川军第四旅残部向汉源方向溃退。飞越岭一战之后，大渡河峡谷不再是红军的障碍。本坐标为飞越岭垭口。
description.en: Feiyueling, also called Dayakou, lies southeast of Luding county town; its pass, Feiyue Pass, is flanked by peaks above 3,000 m and forms a natural gateway between the Sichuan basin and Kham, the last barrier the Central Red Army had to break to leave the Dadu gorge and march north to join the Fourth Front Army. On 31 May 1935 the KMT remnants mined the narrow trail to the summit and held the heights, stalling the Red Army attack, and the two sides locked halfway up the slope. That morning Chen Guang, commander of the 2nd Division, divisional commissar Liu Yalou, 4th Regiment commander Huang Kaixiang (some sources: Wang Kaixiang), and commissar Yang Chengwu reconnoitred at the foot of the mountain and decided to use the mountain fog: Huang Lin, deputy commander of the 2nd Battalion, was sent with the 6th Company and a machine-gun platoon to climb around the left flank. As the troops worked up the narrow track above the mid-slope, a gust of wind tore the cloud away and exposed the crags; Huang Lin judged the flank weakly held and attacked under the fog, took the pass, and the remnants of the KMT 4th Brigade fled toward Hanyuan. After Feiyueling the Dadu gorge no longer blocked the Red Army. The coordinate is the Feiyueling pass.

summary.zh: 中共中央在泸定县城召开政治局常委会议，决定北上雪山草地一线，并派陈云赴上海恢复白区党组织。
summary.en: The Politburo Standing Committee met at Luding and decided to march north through the snow mountains and grasslands and to send Chen Yun to Shanghai to rebuild the underground party.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 31 日，陈云随军委纵队渡过大渡河到达泸定。当晚，中共中央在泸定县城召开政治局常委会议，讨论红军渡过大渡河以后的形势与任务。据陈云回忆，会议主要决定了两件事：一是红军向北走雪山草地一线，避开人烟稠密地区；二是派陈云去上海恢复白区党的组织，并向共产国际汇报红军长征和遵义会议的情况。会议参加者各资料记载略有出入，一般记张闻天、周恩来、毛泽东、朱德、陈云等出席。此前 5 月 29 日磨西会议已就「派陈云出川」作了酝酿，泸定会议将其正式定下。会后陈云化装成商人，经重庆转赴上海，8 月受命赴莫斯科。本坐标为泸定县城代表点。
description.en: On 31 May 1935 Chen Yun crossed the Dadu with the Military Commission column and reached Luding. That evening the Central Committee held a Politburo Standing Committee meeting in Luding county town to discuss the situation and tasks after the Dadu crossing. According to Chen Yun’s recollection, the meeting decided two main things: first, that the Red Army would go north through the snow-mountain and grassland belt, avoiding densely populated areas; second, that Chen Yun would be sent to Shanghai to restore the underground party organization and report on the Long March and the Zunyi conference to the Comintern. Accounts of who attended differ slightly; Zhang Wentian, Zhou Enlai, Mao Zedong, Zhu De, and Chen Yun are usually listed. The question of sending Chen Yun out had already been raised at the Moxi meeting on 29 May, and the Luding meeting settled it formally. Chen Yun then travelled disguised as a merchant via Chongqing to Shanghai and in August was ordered on to Moscow. The coordinate is a representative point at Luding county town.

place.zh: 四川荥经牛背山镇与荥河镇交界泡桐岗（团灵山与香炉山之间）
place.en: Paotonggang on the Niubeishan–Yinghe border, Yingjing, Sichuan (between Tuanling and Xianglu mountains)

summary.zh: 红十三团先期劈山开路，中央红军主力在连日大雨中翻越泡桐岗，数百人陷于泥淖再未起来。
summary.en: The 13th Regiment cut the path first and the Central Red Army main force crossed Paotonggang in days of heavy rain; hundreds of men went down in the mire and never rose.

description.zh: 泡桐岗位于荥经县牛背山镇与荥河镇交界的团灵山与香炉山之间，主峰海拔 2154 米，属四川盆地与青藏高原过渡地带，是国内同纬度降水最多的地区之一，古木参天、荫翳蔽日、人迹罕至。红军将士的日记与回忆中写作「炮筒岗」「炮通岗」，也有记作「甘竹山」的，名称不统一本身就说明此地极其偏远。1935 年 6 月 2 日起中央红军分数路进入荥经县境；6 月 3 日，红三军团第十三团在团长彭雪枫、团政委张爱萍率领下冒雨先期进入泡桐岗，张爱萍带头抡大刀劈山开路，压倒竹子铺在泥淖上为大部队开出一条林间小路。此时中革军委决定由红四团佯攻黄猫岗、十三团严守新庙场，掩护主力翻越泡桐岗、径取天全。因连日大雨，主力在水子地停留至 6 月 5 日，6 月 5 日至 6 日两万余人先后从水子地出发翻越，6 月 2 日至 8 日主力全部通过。上下不过数十公里（一记 15 公里），却是许多老红军记忆里比雪山草地更难走的一段：陈伯钧 6 月 5 日日记写「悬崖数丈，绝壁时生，石坎参差，烂泥太深，攀葛附藤，举足不敢进」；伍云甫 6 月 7 日日记写「其路之难行，从来未有」；谢觉哉《抱桐岗的一夜》写「那知道根本没有路，只有些攀藤负葛的痕迹」，宿营只能倚树偃息；周恩来的警卫员魏国禄记周恩来背靠大树站了一夜。毛泽东后来对斯诺说：「在这个山峰上，有一个军团死掉了三分之二的驮畜，成百上千的战士倒下去就没有再起来。」张爱萍晚年反复说「泡桐岗比雪山草地还要难走」，嘱女儿张小艾寻找确切位置，2005 年张小艾重走长征路用十余小时翻越泡桐岗。本坐标为团灵山与香炉山之间的示意点，精确位置待实测。
description.en: Paotonggang lies between Tuanling and Xianglu mountains on the border of Niubeishan and Yinghe townships in Yingjing county; its main peak is 2,154 m, on the transition between the Sichuan basin and the Tibetan plateau, one of the wettest places at its latitude, with ancient trees shutting out the sky and almost no human traffic. Red Army diaries and memoirs spell it 炮筒岗, 炮通岗, or 甘竹山, and the very inconsistency of the name shows how remote the place was. From 2 June 1935 the Central Red Army entered Yingjing in several columns; on 3 June the 13th Regiment of the 3rd Army Corps, under commander Peng Xuefeng and commissar Zhang Aiping, went into Paotonggang in the rain ahead of the main body, Zhang Aiping leading with a big sword to cut the way and felling bamboo to lay over the mire for a forest track. The Military Commission then decided that the 4th Regiment would feint at Huangmaogang and the 13th Regiment hold Xinmiaochang, covering the main force’s crossing of Paotonggang and its drive on Tianquan. Held up by heavy rain, the main force waited at Shuizidi until 5 June; on 5 and 6 June over 20,000 troops set out from Shuizidi and crossed, and by 8 June the whole main force was through. The climb was only some tens of kilometres (one account says 15), yet many veterans remembered it as harder than the snow mountains or the grasslands: Chen Bojun’s diary for 5 June records cliffs several zhang high, sheer rock, broken stone steps, mud too deep to move in, hauling on vines and creepers and not daring to take a step; Wu Yunfu’s diary for 7 June calls the road the worst he had ever seen; Xie Juezai’s “A Night at Baotonggang” says there was no road at all, only traces of climbers’ ropes and creepers, and the troops could only lean against trees to rest; Wei Guolu, Zhou Enlai’s guard, records Zhou standing propped against a tree all night. Mao later told Snow: “On this mountain one army corps lost two thirds of its pack animals. Hundreds and thousands of men sank down and never rose again.” Zhang Aiping said repeatedly in old age that Paotonggang was harder than the snow mountains and grasslands and asked his daughter Zhang Xiao’ai to find the exact spot; in 2005 she retraced the Long March and spent over ten hours crossing Paotonggang. The coordinate is a schematic point between Tuanling and Xianglu mountains; the exact site remains to be surveyed.

name.zh: 茶合岗空袭与胡长保牺牲
name.en: Air Raid at Chahegang and the Death of Hu Changbao

place.zh: 四川荥经牛背山镇茶合岗（原三合乡建政村一带）
place.en: Chahegang, Niubeishan, Yingjing, Sichuan (formerly Sanhe township)

summary.zh: 中央红军在荥经茶合岗遭敌机轰炸，警卫班长胡长保扑身掩护毛泽东，腹部中弹牺牲。
summary.en: During an air raid at Chahegang in Yingjing, guard squad leader Hu Changbao threw himself over Mao Zedong and was killed by bomb fragments.

description.zh: 1935 年 6 月 2 日起，中央红军强渡大渡河、飞夺泸定桥后分数路进入荥经县境，蒋介石调集二十余万人沿雅安、荥经、天全、芦山一带围追堵截。6 月 4 日，中央红军主力行军至荥经县三合乡（今牛背山镇）茶合岗，这里是一片地势较开阔的竹林地，缺少遮蔽。三架敌机从水子地方向飞来，在军委警卫营上空盘旋扫射投弹；一枚炸弹落向毛泽东所在位置，警卫班班长胡长保扑上前将毛泽东推开，用身体掩护，腹部中弹牺牲。胡长保是江西吉安人，1930 年参加红军，1934 年初任中央红军警卫团毛泽东警卫班长，牺牲时年仅二十三四岁（各资料记 23 岁或 24 岁，出生年有 1911、1912 两说；名字亦有一作「胡昌保」）。毛泽东取自己的被子盖在他身上，脱帽默立，随后部队在距茶合岗约半里的水子地将他就地掩埋。1990 年荥经县寻访到遗骸，迁葬荥经县烈士陵园，并建胡长保烈士纪念馆。本坐标为建政村一带代表点，茶合岗精确位置待实测。
description.en: From 2 June 1935, having forced the Dadu and taken Luding Bridge, the Central Red Army entered Yingjing county in several columns while Chiang Kai-shek massed over 200,000 troops along the Ya’an–Yingjing–Tianquan–Lushan line. On 4 June the main force reached Chahegang in Sanhe township (present-day Niubeishan), an open bamboo grove with little cover. Three aircraft came in from the direction of Shuizidi and strafed and bombed the Military Commission guard battalion; a bomb fell toward Mao Zedong, and guard squad leader Hu Changbao pushed him aside and shielded him with his body, taking fragments in the abdomen. Hu was from Ji’an, Jiangxi, joined the Red Army in 1930, and became Mao’s guard squad leader in the Central Red Army guard regiment in early 1934; he was 23 or 24 (sources give both, with birth years of 1911 and 1912, and the name is sometimes written Hu Changbao 胡昌保). Mao covered the body with his own quilt and stood bareheaded for a long while, and the unit buried him on the spot at Shuizidi about half a li away. In 1990 Yingjing county located the grave, reinterred the remains in the county martyrs’ cemetery, and built the Hu Changbao Memorial Hall. The coordinate is a representative point in Jianzheng village; the exact site of Chahegang remains to be surveyed.

place.zh: 四川荥经牛背山镇水子地（茶合岗以东约半里）
place.en: Shuizidi, Niubeishan, Yingjing, Sichuan (about half a li east of Chahegang)

summary.zh: 红军因连日大雨在水子地暂停集结，6 月 5 日起两万余人由此出发翻越泡桐岗。
summary.en: Held up by days of heavy rain, the Red Army paused at Shuizidi, and from 5 June over 20,000 troops set out from there to cross Paotonggang.

description.zh: 水子地（陈云《随军西行见闻录》写作「水子田」）在茶合岗以东约半里，是泡桐岗西侧山脚的一处小村落。1935 年 6 月 4 日茶合岗遭空袭、胡长保牺牲后，红军就地将烈士掩埋于水子地，并因连日大雨在此暂停集结。6 月 5 日至 6 日，两万余人先后从水子地出发，经泡桐岗向东北方向的天全前进；陈云记「我等由水子地出发，经一高山，几天来亦无石阶，两旁竹林丛生，遮挡天空，山上泥水极深，两腿全在泥沟中爬行。部队几乎是在泥泞中泡了一天」。水子地因此既是空袭后的临时集结地，也是主力翻越泡桐岗的出发点和胡长保最初的埋葬处。本坐标为茶合岗以东村落代表点，精确位置待实测。
description.en: Shuizidi (written Shuizitian in Chen Yun’s Random Notes on the Long March) lies about half a li east of Chahegang, a small hamlet at the western foot of Paotonggang. After the air raid of 4 June 1935 and Hu Changbao’s death, the Red Army buried him on the spot at Shuizidi and, held up by days of heavy rain, paused there to assemble. On 5 and 6 June over 20,000 troops set out from Shuizidi for Tianquan to the northeast by way of Paotonggang; Chen Yun wrote that they left Shuizidi, crossed a high mountain with no stone steps for days, bamboo thickets shutting out the sky, mud and water deep on the slopes so that both legs crawled in the mud, and that the units were soaked in mire for a whole day. Shuizidi was thus both the assembly point after the air raid and the starting point for the crossing of Paotonggang, and the place where Hu Changbao was first buried. The coordinate is a representative point for the hamlet east of Chahegang; the exact site remains to be surveyed.

summary.zh: 中央红军由泸定北上，突破川军阻击，占领天全，打开通往宝兴、夹金山的道路。
summary.en: Moving north from Luding, the Central Red Army broke through Sichuan army blocking forces and took Tianquan, opening the road to Baoxing and Mount Jiajin.

description.zh: 1935 年 6 月 2 日中央红军全部由泸定桥渡过天险大渡河后继续北上，经化林坪、飞越岭进入汉源、荥经一带。6 月 7 日，红军占领天全，突破川军杨森部等部的拦阻（有综述记「突破杨森部六个旅的阻击」，各资料对参战番号与兵力记载不一，本条目只记「川军阻击」）。天全是由川西平原西缘进入宝兴、翻越夹金山的必经之地，红军占领天全后继续向芦山、宝兴推进。另有个别资料把占领天全的时间记在 6 月 8 日前后，本条目取 6 月 7 日。本坐标为天全县城代表点。
description.en: After the whole Central Red Army crossed the Dadu by Luding Bridge on 2 June 1935 it continued north through Hualinping and Feiyueling into the Hanyuan and Yingjing area. On 7 June the Red Army took Tianquan, breaking through blocking forces of Yang Sen’s Sichuan troops (one survey speaks of “six brigades of Yang Sen’s force,” but sources differ on the units and strengths involved, so this entry says only “Sichuan army blocking forces”). Tianquan was the necessary gateway from the western edge of the Chengdu plain into Baoxing and on to Mount Jiajin, and after taking it the Red Army pushed on toward Lushan and Baoxing. A few sources place the capture of Tianquan around 8 June; this entry uses 7 June. The coordinate is a representative point at Tianquan county town.

sources.title: 《“图步”长征路，纪念长征胜利 85 周年》
sources.author: 共产党员网
sources.note: 用于核对中央红军抵达宝兴、翻越夹金山与 6 月 18 日全部翻越完毕

place.zh: 四川芦山（防线横亘芦山—宝兴）
place.en: Lushan, Sichuan (the line ran from Lushan to Baoxing)

summary.zh: 中央红军一举突破川军芦山、宝兴防线，进抵宝兴以北的硗碛地区，直逼夹金山。
summary.en: The Central Red Army broke the Sichuan army’s Lushan–Baoxing line in one stroke and reached Qiaoqi north of Baoxing, at the foot of Mount Jiajin.

description.zh: 1935 年 6 月 8 日，为迅速完成与红四方面军会合的战略任务，中共中央、中革军委发出指示：「我军基本任务，是用一切努力，不顾一切困难，取得与四方面军直接会合」「我军必须以迅雷之势突破芦山、宝兴线之守敌，奇取懋功，控制小金川流域于我手中，以为前进之枢纽」。同日，红军一举突破川军芦山、宝兴防线，随后进抵宝兴以北的硗碛（大硗碛）地区，来到夹金山脚下。芦山、宝兴一线是川军阻拦红军西进川西北的最后一道防线，突破之后红军面前只剩下雪山草地。本坐标为芦山县城代表点。
description.en: On 8 June 1935, to accomplish quickly the strategic task of joining the Fourth Front Army, the Central Committee and the Military Commission issued a directive: “our basic task is, with every effort and regardless of all difficulties, to achieve direct junction with the Fourth Front Army” and “we must break the enemy holding the Lushan–Baoxing line with the speed of thunder, seize Maogong by surprise, and hold the Xiaojin River valley as the pivot for our advance.” That same day the Red Army broke the Sichuan army’s Lushan–Baoxing line in one stroke and moved on to the Qiaoqi (Daqiaoqi) area north of Baoxing, at the foot of Mount Jiajin. The Lushan–Baoxing line was the last Sichuan army barrier against the Red Army’s move into northwestern Sichuan; beyond it lay only the snow mountains and grasslands. The coordinate is a representative point at Lushan county town.

name.en: Seizure of Maogong and Advance to Dawei

aliases.zh: 李先念率部迎接中央红军
aliases.en: Li Xiannian’s Force Moves to Meet the Central Red Army

summary.zh: 李先念率红三十军等部攻占懋功、前出达维，扫清沿途敌军并筹备粮盐，迎接中央红军。
summary.en: Li Xiannian’s 30th Army and attached units took Maogong and pushed on to Dawei, clearing the road and stockpiling food and salt to receive the Central Red Army.

description.zh: 1935 年 6 月上旬，红四方面军总部获悉中央红军已渡过泸定桥北上，即派第三十军政委李先念率第三十军和第九军各一部前往懋功（今小金）方向迎接，并要求部队扫清沿途敌人、筹粮熬盐、制作慰劳品。6 月 8 日红四方面军一部攻占懋功，6 月 9 日占领懋功东南的达维镇。李先念后来回忆：「一、四方面军在四川省懋功会师，是有重大历史意义的事件」「我们早就盼望见到党中央和一方面军了」。6 月 12 日，中央红军先头部队翻越夹金山到达达维，与红四方面军第三十军李先念部会师；6 月 18 日中共中央与中央红军主力到达懋功。本坐标为懋功（小金）县城代表点，达维镇在其东南约 26 公里处。
description.en: In early June 1935, learning that the Central Red Army had crossed Luding Bridge and was moving north, the Fourth Front Army headquarters sent Li Xiannian, commissar of the 30th Army, with the 30th Army and parts of the 9th Army toward Maogong (present-day Xiaojin) to meet it, ordering them to clear the enemy along the way and to prepare grain, boiled salt, and gifts for the arriving comrades. On 8 June a Fourth Front Army force took Maogong, and on 9 June it occupied Dawei southeast of the town. Li Xiannian later recalled: “the meeting of the First and Fourth Front Armies at Maogong in Sichuan was an event of great historical significance” and “we had long been hoping to see the Party Centre and the First Front Army.” On 12 June the Central Red Army’s advance guard crossed Mount Jiajin to Dawei and joined Li Xiannian’s 30th Army; on 18 June the Central Committee and the Central Red Army main force reached Maogong. The coordinate is a representative point at Maogong (Xiaojin) county town; Dawei lies about 26 km to its southeast.

name.zh: 大硗碛休整与翻山动员
name.en: Rest and Mountain-Crossing Preparations at Qiaoqi

place.zh: 四川宝兴硗碛藏族乡（大硗碛）

summary.zh: 红军进抵夹金山下的硗碛，宣布民族与群众纪律，召开翻山动员大会，备竹杖与干辣椒御寒。
summary.en: At Qiaoqi below Mount Jiajin the Red Army announced discipline, held a mobilization meeting, and prepared staffs and dried chillies against the cold.

description.zh: 硗碛（大硗碛）位于宝兴县北部、夹金山以南，是藏、汉杂居的山间村寨。1935 年 6 月 11 日中午，红军进寨，当地汉藏百姓在门前摆好果品、燃放鞭炮、敲锣打鼓迎接。进寨后红军当场宣布纪律：不进老百姓的住房，保护寺院，不随便吃群众的东西，不拿走「夷家」一点财物，并宣传民族平等主张。经过简单休整，中央红军在硗碛附近召开翻越雪山的动员大会，要求战士砍竹竿、粗树枝做拐杖，把从天全、芦山一带买来的干辣椒发给每人御寒，并把仅有的衣物尽量补给体弱者。6 月 12 日先头部队由此出发翻越夹金山，随后在达维与红四方面军一部会师。本坐标为硗碛藏族乡代表点。
description.en: Qiaoqi (Daqiaoqi), a mountain village of mixed Tibetan and Han households north of Baoxing and south of Mount Jiajin, received the Red Army at midday on 11 June 1935: villagers set out fruit before their doors and welcomed the troops with firecrackers and gongs. On entering, the Red Army announced its rules on the spot — no entering people’s houses, protection of monasteries, no taking of villagers’ food, no seizure of the “Yi families’” property — and publicized its policy of ethnic equality. After a short rest the Central Red Army held a mobilization meeting near Qiaoqi for the crossing of the snow mountain, telling soldiers to cut bamboo and branches for staffs, distributing dried chillies bought around Tianquan and Lushan for warmth, and giving what clothing there was to the weakest. On 12 June the advance guard set out over Mount Jiajin and subsequently joined a detachment of the Fourth Front Army at Dawei. The coordinate is a representative point at Qiaoqi township.

summary.zh: 红一军团第二师第四团与红四方面军第九军第二十五师第七十四团在达维会师。
summary.en: The Fourth Regiment of the Second Division, First Army Corps, met the 74th Regiment of the 25th Division, Ninth Army, Fourth Front Army at Dawei.

description.zh: 1935 年 6 月 12 日，中央红军先头部队红一军团第二师第四团翻越夹金山后，在达维以南、夹金山北麓木城沟与红四方面军第九军第二十五师第七十四团相遇，双方吹号联络确认身份，在达维会师桥会合。6 月 17 日，毛泽东、周恩来、朱德等率中央机关到达达维，红二十五师列队迎接；6 月 18 日中央红军主力到达懋功，与红四方面军主力会师。本坐标为达维会师桥代表点。
description.en: On 12 June 1935, the Fourth Regiment of the Second Division, First Army Corps, crossed the Jiajin Mountains and met the 74th Regiment of the 25th Division, Ninth Army, Fourth Front Army at Mucheng Gully below the mountain south of Dawei. The two sides identified each other by bugle calls and joined at the Dawei meeting bridge. On 17 June Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai, Zhu De, and the central organs reached Dawei, where the 25th Division lined the road to welcome them; on 18 June the main force reached Maogong and met the main force of the Fourth Front Army. The coordinate is a representative point at the Dawei meeting bridge.

aliases.en: Cadre Meeting at the Catholic Church

place.zh: 四川懋功（今小金）县城天主教堂
place.en: Catholic church, Maogong (Xiaojin) county town, Sichuan

summary.zh: 红军总政治部在懋功县城天主教堂召开会师联欢庆祝会，两军会合后总兵力达十余万人。
summary.en: The Red Army’s General Political Department held a link-up celebration at the Catholic church in Maogong; the combined forces numbered over 100,000.

description.zh: 1935 年 6 月 18 日，中共中央率中央机关离开达维到达懋功（今小金），受到担负接应任务的红三十军政治委员李先念所率第八十八师部队欢迎。6 月 21 日，红军总政治部在懋功县城天主教堂召开会师联欢庆祝会（另有记载称在县城天主教堂召开干部大会，并在城隍庙举行庆祝会师的联欢会），红一、红四方面军部队代表参加，演唱陆定一编写的《两大主力会合歌》。两军会合后总兵力达十余万人，是长征途中规模最大的一次会师。会师后中央电请张国焘立即赶来懋功「以便商决一切」，为 6 月 26 日的两河口会议作了准备。本坐标为懋功县城代表点，天主教堂与城隍庙的具体会址待落位。
description.en: On 18 June 1935 the Central Committee left Dawei with its organs and reached Maogong (present-day Xiaojin), where it was welcomed by the 88th Division troops under Li Xiannian, political commissar of the 30th Army, who had been sent to meet it. On 21 June the Red Army’s General Political Department held a link-up celebration at the Catholic church in Maogong county town (other accounts say a cadre meeting was held at the Catholic church and a celebration at the City God temple), with representatives of the First and Fourth Front Armies and the singing of Lu Dingyi’s “Song of the Meeting of the Two Main Forces.” The combined forces came to more than 100,000 men, the largest link-up of the Long March. Afterwards the Centre telegraphed Zhang Guotao to come at once to Maogong “to settle everything together,” preparing the way for the Lianghekou meeting of 26 June. The coordinate is a representative point at Maogong county town; the exact sites of the church and temple remain to be fixed.

name.zh: 两河口会师大会与张国焘到两河口
name.en: Lianghekou Rally and Zhang Guotao’s Arrival

place.zh: 四川懋功（今小金）两河口镇外会场
place.en: The rally ground outside Lianghekou, Maogong (Xiaojin), Sichuan

summary.zh: 张国焘由茂县赶到两河口，中央领导冒雨在镇外会场举行欢迎大会，朱德致欢迎词。
summary.en: Zhang Guotao reached Lianghekou from Mao county and the Central Committee leaders welcomed him in the rain at a rally ground outside the town, with Zhu De giving the address.

description.zh: 1935 年 6 月 20 日，中共中央致电张国焘，要他立即赶到懋功两河口商谈会师后的行动问题。6 月 25 日，尚在茂县的张国焘带警卫部队经威州、理番赶到两河口。毛泽东、张闻天、周恩来、朱德、博古、刘伯承等中央领导和红一方面军指战员冒雨在镇外会场欢迎，会前由工兵把一片荒坡开辟成会场、用沙土铺平地面；朱德致欢迎词，张国焘代表红四方面军讲话。欢迎大会的地址另有记为「两河口镇抚边村外」者，与会人员步行三里迎接一说亦见于记述。这次会面把两个方面军的领导人聚到一处，次日即召开两河口会议。本坐标为两河口镇代表点。
description.en: On 20 June 1935 the Central Committee telegraphed Zhang Guotao to come at once to Lianghekou in Maogong to discuss action after the link-up. On 25 June Zhang, still at Mao county, came with his guard unit by way of Weizhou and Lifan. Mao Zedong, Zhang Wentian, Zhou Enlai, Zhu De, Bo Gu, Liu Bocheng, and other leaders and First Front Army troops welcomed him in the rain at a rally ground outside the town, which engineers had cut out of a waste slope and levelled with sand; Zhu De gave the address of welcome and Zhang Guotao spoke for the Fourth Front Army. Some accounts place the rally “outside Fubian village, Lianghekou,” and some say the leaders walked three li to meet him. The meeting brought the leaders of the two front armies together, and the Lianghekou conference opened the next day. The coordinate is a representative point at Lianghekou.

aliases.zh: 两河口政治局扩大会议

summary.zh: 中央政治局在两河口决定集中主力北上，创造川陕甘根据地。
summary.en: The Politburo met at Lianghekou and decided to concentrate the main force northward to create the Sichuan–Shaanxi–Gansu base area.

description.zh: 1935 年 6 月 26 日，中央政治局在懋功以北两河口召开扩大会议，通过《关于一、四方面军会合后战略方针的决定》，决定集中主力向北进攻，在运动战中消灭敌人，首先取得甘肃南部，创造川陕甘苏区根据地。张国焘在会上表示同意，会后以“组织问题”为由拖延北上。本坐标为两河口镇代表点，会议会址待进一步落位。
description.en: On 26 June 1935 the Politburo held an enlarged meeting at Lianghekou north of Maogong and adopted the “Decision on the Strategic Policy after the Meeting of the First and Fourth Front Armies”. It decided to concentrate the main force for a northward attack, destroy the enemy in mobile warfare, first take southern Gansu, and create the Sichuan–Shaanxi–Gansu Soviet base. Zhang Guotao agreed at the meeting but afterwards delayed the northward move on the pretext of “organizational questions”. The coordinate is a representative point at Lianghekou; the meeting site awaits further placement.

place.zh: 四川小金、马尔康交界梦笔山垭口
place.en: Mengbi Mountain pass on the Xiaojin–Maerkang border, Sichuan

summary.zh: 中央红军翻越梦笔山，继续北上卓克基、两河口方向。
summary.en: The Central Red Army crossed Mengbi Mountain and continued north toward Zhuokeji and Lianghekou.

description.zh: 1935 年 6 月 26 日两河口会议后，中央红军于 6 月 27 日由两河口北上，翻越梦笔山垭口（海拔约 4080—4114 米），进入马尔康卓克基一带。梦笔山是小金与马尔康的界山，红四方面军部队此后亦曾翻越。本坐标为梦笔山垭口代表点。
description.en: After the Lianghekou meeting of 26 June 1935, the Central Red Army moved north from Lianghekou on 27 June and crossed the Mengbi Mountain pass (about 4,080–4,114 m) into the Zhuokeji area of Maerkang. Mengbi Mountain lies on the Xiaojin–Maerkang border; Fourth Front Army units also crossed it later. The coordinate is a representative point at the Mengbi pass.

name.zh: 攻占卓克基与进驻官寨
name.en: Seizure of Zhuokeji and Occupation of the Chieftain’s Fortress

place.zh: 四川马尔康卓克基镇西索村（卓克基土司官寨）
place.en: Xisuo village, Zhuokeji, Maerkang, Sichuan (Zhuokeji chieftain’s fortress)

summary.zh: 红六团攻占卓克基土司官寨，中央机关与主力同日进驻，官寨成为北上总后方。
summary.en: The 6th Regiment took the Zhuokeji chieftain’s fortress, where the Central Committee organs and main force arrived the same day; the fortress became the rear base for the march north.

description.zh: 1935 年 6 月 26 日至 28 日两河口会议期间，红一方面军先头部队自两河口出发，翻越梦笔山进入马尔康境内。6 月 29 日，先头红六团攻占卓克基。卓克基土司索观瀛受国民党政府宣传蛊惑，派兵据守官寨，在深谷中开枪阻击，红军一名向导牺牲；相持至夜晚大雨倾盆，红军先头部队为联络后续部队向天空发射三颗彩色信号弹，夜空通明，土司兵从未见过，以为红军施法术、放「神火」，仓皇弃寨而逃，连土司大印都未及带走。同日，中共中央、中央军委与中央红军主力、红四方面军第三十军第八十八师主力翻越梦笔山到达卓克基地区。红军进驻官寨后严守纪律、不扰百姓，并派人寻找土司宣讲民族政策。毛泽东、朱德、周恩来等在官寨住宿数日，毛泽东翻阅土司书房的《三国演义》《古文观止》，称「古有郿坞，今有官寨，土司的这个城堡应该是我们在长征途中见到的最有特色的建筑了」。此后卓克基成为红军北上的后勤基地，《松潘战役计划》《夏洮战役计划》都把卓克基列为总后方，马尔康一带先后建立 13 个乡级苏维埃组织。1952 年索观瀛到北京参加「五一」观礼，毛泽东邀他同桌就餐，说「红军当年是借路北上，住进官寨，你用不着躲进山林里」。本坐标为官寨所在西索村代表点。
description.en: During the Lianghekou conference of 26–28 June 1935 the advance guard of the First Front Army moved up from Lianghekou, crossed Mount Mengbi, and entered Maerkang. On 29 June the 6th Regiment took Zhuokeji. The Zhuokeji chieftain Suo Guanying, stirred up by Nationalist propaganda, had his men hold the fortress and open fire in the ravine, killing a Red Army guide; the stand lasted into the night, when heavy rain fell and the advance guard, to signal the following troops, fired three coloured flares. The night sky lit up, and the chieftain’s soldiers, who had never seen such a thing, took it for magic or “divine fire” and abandoned the fortress in panic, leaving even the chieftain’s seal behind. That same day the Central Committee, the Military Commission, the First Front Army main force, and the main force of the Fourth Front Army’s 88th Division crossed Mount Mengbi and reached the Zhuokeji area. The Red Army kept strict discipline in the fortress, did not disturb the villagers, and sent men to find the chieftain and explain its nationality policy. Mao Zedong, Zhu De, and Zhou Enlai stayed several days; Mao read Romance of the Three Kingdoms and Guwen Guanzhi from the chieftain’s library and remarked: “In old times there was Meiwu; today there is the fortress. This castle of the chieftain’s must be the most distinctive building we have seen on the Long March.” Zhuokeji then became the Red Army’s rear base for the march north, named as general rear depot in both the Songpan and Xiatao campaign plans, and thirteen township-level soviets were set up around Maerkang. In 1952 Suo Guanying came to Beijing for the May Day parade and Mao invited him to his table, saying: “The Red Army was only borrowing the road north and stayed in your fortress; there was no need to hide in the hills.” The coordinate is a representative point at Xisuo village, site of the fortress.

place.en: Chieftain’s council hall, second floor, Zhuokeji fortress, Maerkang, Sichuan

summary.zh: 中央政治局常委在卓克基官寨开会，通过《告康藏西番民众书》，确定民族平等与民族革命纲领。
summary.en: The Politburo Standing Committee met in the Zhuokeji fortress and adopted the “Proclamation to the Tibetan People of Kham and Tibet,” setting out equality and national revolution policy.

description.zh: 1935 年 7 月 3 日，中共中央政治局常务委员会在卓克基土司官寨二楼「土司议政厅」召开会议，即卓克基会议。会议专门讨论民族地区的有关问题，通过《中国共产党中央委员会告康藏西番民众书——进行西藏民族革命运动的斗争纲领》，指出中国共产党的民族政策是解放被压迫的各民族、建立自由选举的革命政府，号召藏族民众反对帝国主义及国民党军阀。《告康藏西番民众书》的广泛张贴与配套宣传，逐步打消了当地部分土司和民众的疑虑，是红军在川西北民族地区立足的关键一步。中央机关与中央领导人在官寨驻留约一周，7 月中旬经梭磨、马塘向黑水前进。本坐标为官寨代表点，会议房间即官寨二楼议政厅。
description.en: On 3 July 1935 the Politburo Standing Committee of the Central Committee met in the chieftain’s council hall on the second floor of the Zhuokeji fortress — the Zhuokeji meeting. It dealt specifically with questions in the nationality areas and adopted the “Proclamation of the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party to the Tibetan People of Kham and Tibet: A Programme of Struggle for the National Revolutionary Movement in Tibet,” stating that the Party’s nationality policy was to liberate the oppressed nationalities and establish freely elected revolutionary governments, and calling on Tibetans to oppose imperialism and the Nationalist warlords. The wide posting of the proclamation and the accompanying publicity gradually dispelled the misgivings of some local chieftains and common people, a key step in the Red Army’s establishing itself in the nationality areas of northwestern Sichuan. The Central Committee organs and leaders stayed about a week, moving on in mid-July by way of Suomo and Matang toward Heishui. The coordinate is a representative point at the fortress; the meeting room is the council hall on its second floor.

summary.zh: 红一军团主力配属红三十军围攻毛儿盖，胡宗南部李日基营据寺顽抗七日后夜遁，红军占领毛儿盖，打开北上通道。
summary.en: The First Army Corps with the 30th Army besieged Maoergai; Li Riji’s battalion held the temple for a week and then slipped away at night, and the Red Army took Maoergai, opening the road north.

description.zh: 1935 年 7 月初，蒋介石调十多个团赶赴松潘防堵红军，胡宗南命令第一师补充旅第二团加强营营长李日基带队抢占毛儿盖。红军攻松潘未克后，以红一军团主力配属红三十军转攻毛儿盖。7 月 9 日，红军向李日基部发起五次攻击均未奏效；战至 7 月 15 日，李日基接到胡宗南准许撤退的命令，借夜暗率全营六百余人由寺庙东北方向突围，直奔松潘，红军追击俘敌一百余人；7 月 16 日下午，红一军团将李日基残部包围于腊子山以西二十五公里处，士兵纷纷举枪投降，李日基从山上滚下逃脱。另有记载称先头部队 7 月 10 日到达毛儿盖、守敌一个营被缴械、俘敌三百余、缴获轻重机枪三十六挺与电台一部；《中国共产党历史》则记 7 月 16 日先头部队抵达松潘附近的毛儿盖。各说不一，事件起止取 7 月 9 日至 16 日。毛儿盖此后成为中共中央与右路军的集结地，红军在此驻留四十余天。本坐标为毛儿盖镇代表点。
description.en: In early July 1935 Chiang Kai-shek sent more than ten regiments to hold Songpan, and Hu Zongnan ordered Li Riji, commander of the reinforced battalion of the 1st Division’s replacement brigade, to seize Maoergai first. After the attack on Songpan failed, the main force of the First Army Corps, with the 30th Army under it, turned on Maoergai. On 9 July the Red Army launched five assaults on Li’s battalion without success; by 15 July Li had Hu Zongnan’s permission to withdraw and slipped out of the temple to the northeast at night with over 600 men, making for Songpan, while the Red Army pursued and took more than 100 prisoners; on the afternoon of 16 July the First Army Corps surrounded the remnant 25 km west of Lazishan, where the soldiers surrendered and Li escaped by rolling down the hillside. Other accounts say the advance force reached Maoergai on 10 July, disarmed a battalion, took over 300 prisoners and captured 36 machine guns and a radio set, while Party History of the CCP records the advance force reaching Maoergai near Songpan on 16 July. The accounts differ, and the event is dated 9–16 July. Maoergai then became the assembly area of the Central Committee and the Right Route Army, where the Red Army stayed for over forty days. The coordinate is a representative point at Maoergai town.

summary.zh: 中央机关与中央领导经长板山进入黑水，7 月 10 日进驻芦花寨，在此休整筹粮并为芦花会议作准备。
summary.en: Having crossed Mount Changban into Heishui, the Central Committee organs and leaders reached Luhua on 10 July, resting and collecting grain there before the Luhua meeting.

description.zh: 1935 年 7 月 2 日，红一方面军第一军团和红四方面军第三十军各一部组成的先头部队翻越长板山（雅克夏山）进入黑水；7 月 9 日，红一方面军主力翻越同一座雪山进入黑水境内，随后进抵芦花。7 月 10 日，中共中央主要领导人到达黑水县芦花寨。黑水县境内有大黑水、小黑水与毛儿盖河三大水系，县以河名，县城即芦花镇；红军在此休整一周余，一边筹粮、一边等待张国焘北上，7 月 18 日起在芦花召开政治局常委扩大会议（芦花会议），7 月 21—22 日继续开政治局扩大会议解决组织与前敌指挥问题。7 月下旬，中央机关离开芦花，经昌德、打古翻越昌德山、达古山向毛儿盖前进。本坐标为芦花镇代表点，中央机关驻地与芦花会议会址待进一步落位。
description.en: On 2 July 1935 an advance force made up of units of the First Army Corps and the Fourth Front Army’s 30th Army crossed Mount Changban (Yakexia) into Heishui; on 9 July the main force of the First Front Army crossed the same snow mountain into Heishui and went on to Luhua. On 10 July the principal leaders of the Central Committee reached Luhua village in Heishui county. The county takes its name from its three river systems — the Greater and Lesser Heishui and the Maoergai river — and its county town is Luhua; the Red Army rested there for more than a week, collecting grain and waiting for Zhang Guotao to come north, and from 18 July held the enlarged meeting of the Politburo Standing Committee known as the Luhua meeting, continuing on 21–22 July with an enlarged Politburo meeting on organisation and the forward command. In late July the Central Committee organs left Luhua and moved toward Maoergai by way of Changde and Dagu and over the Changde and Dagu passes. The coordinate is a representative point at Luhua town; the exact sites of the Central Committee’s quarters and of the meeting remain to be fixed.

name.en: Grain Collection at Maoergai and the “Wheat-Cutting Certificates”

place.zh: 四川松潘毛儿盖镇克藏村一带

summary.zh: 红军在毛儿盖以木板借据向藏民购粮，割一坵青稞即留一块“割麦证”，成为长征群众纪律的物证。
summary.en: At Maoergai the Red Army bought grain from Tibetans with wooden receipts, leaving a “wheat-cutting certificate” in every field it reaped — physical proof of Long March discipline.

description.zh: 1935 年 7 月，红一方面军先头部队从黑水翻越打古山到达松潘以西的毛儿盖克藏村。这里属藏区，时值青稞将熟，但村庄空无一人：红军到达前，当地藏民听信国民党的污名化宣传，认为红军是青面獠牙的恶魔，纷纷躲进深山。7 月高原青稞尚未成熟，红军在毛儿盖驻留四十余天等待收割，随后自己动手割麦、搓粒、炒熟，再运到河边水磨坊磨成面粉。为不损群众利益，红军总政治部规定：每个部队收了哪块地，必须在田头立一块“割麦牌”，写明收割数量，群众归来后可持牌向任何红军部队或苏维埃政府兑取与青稞价值相等的银子、茶叶等物。现存国家一级文物的一块木板顶部横书“割麦证”，下方竖排小楷写：“老庚：我们在这坵田内割了青稞一仟斤，我们自己吃了，这块木牌可作我们购买你们这些青稞的证据。请你们归来以后，拿住这块木牌，向任何红军部队或苏维埃政府，都可兑取与我们吃你们青稞价值相等的银子、茶叶与你们所需要的东西，在你们还未曾兑得这些东西前需要好好保存这块木牌子。前敌总政治部　麦田第××号。”2011 年克藏村藏族女村民仁青卓玛家翻修房屋，从旧木板中发现此牌，经识字的木匠与离休干部尼麦上报，得以保存，现藏四川松潘县红军长征纪念馆；毛儿盖一带先后发现三块木质借据，另两块一捐一藏。因当地藏民大多不识汉文，不少借条被当柴烧掉或改作壁板、粮仓盖。本坐标为克藏村一带示意点，精确位置待实测。
description.en: In July 1935 the advance force of the First Front Army crossed Mount Dagu from Heishui and reached Kezang village at Maoergai, west of Songpan. This was Tibetan country, the barley was nearly ripe, and the village was empty: before the Red Army arrived the people had been told it was a horned monster and had fled into the mountains. The barley was not yet ripe in July, and the Red Army waited at Maoergai for over forty days, then reaped it themselves, rubbed out the grain, parched it, and carried it to water mills by the river to grind into flour. To avoid harming the people, the General Political Department laid down that every unit which reaped a field must plant a “wheat-cutting board” at its edge stating how much had been taken, so that when the owners returned they could exchange it with any Red Army unit or soviet government for silver, tea, or whatever they needed to the value of the barley. A board now listed as a Grade One national cultural relic reads, across the top, “Wheat-Cutting Certificate,” and below in vertical columns: “Old friend: we cut 1,000 jin of barley in this field and ate it ourselves; this board serves as our evidence of purchase. When you return, take this board to any Red Army unit or soviet government and you may exchange it for silver, tea, or whatever you need to the value of the barley we ate; until then please keep this board safe. Forward General Political Department, Field No. XX.” In 2011, when the Tibetan villager Renqing Zhuoma’s family was renovating their house in Kezang, the board came to light among old timbers; a literate carpenter and the retired cadre Nyimai reported it and it was preserved. It is now in the Songpan Red Army Long March Memorial Hall, and three such receipts have been found around Maoergai, one donated and one wrapped in a khata and kept. Because few Tibetans there read Chinese, many receipts were burned as firewood or reused as wall boards and granary lids. The coordinate is a schematic point for the Kezang area; the exact site remains to be surveyed.

summary.zh: 中央政治局在芦花开会，解决统一指挥与四方面军工作问题。
summary.en: The Politburo met at Luhua to settle unified command and the work of the Fourth Front Army.

description.zh: 1935 年 7 月 18 日，中央政治局常委会议在芦花召开，同意周恩来辞去红军总政委，任命张国焘为红军总政委、军委总负责者；7 月 21—22 日政治局扩大会议听取张国焘、徐向前、陈昌浩关于红四方面军的报告，肯定其成绩，批评退出鄂豫皖、放弃通南巴等错误，并决定组织前敌总指挥部，徐向前任总指挥、陈昌浩任政委、叶剑英任参谋长。本坐标为芦花镇代表点，会址待进一步落位。
description.en: On 18 July 1935 the Politburo Standing Committee met at Luhua and agreed that Zhou Enlai should resign as political commissar of the Red Army, appointing Zhang Guotao as political commissar and head of the Military Commission. On 21–22 July an enlarged Politburo meeting heard reports from Zhang Guotao, Xu Xiangqian, and Chen Changhao on the Fourth Front Army, affirmed its achievements, criticized errors including the withdrawal from the Hubei–Henan–Anhui base and the abandonment of Tongnanba, and decided to form the Front Command with Xu Xiangqian as commander, Chen Changhao as political commissar, and Ye Jianying as chief of staff. The coordinate is a representative point at Luhua; the meeting site awaits further placement.

name.zh: 松潘战役计划流产与《夏洮战役计划》
name.en: Abandonment of the Songpan Campaign and the Xiatao Plan

place.zh: 四川松潘毛儿盖（中央与红军总部所在地）
place.en: Maoergai, Songpan, Sichuan (seat of the Central Committee and Red Army headquarters)

summary.zh: 胡宗南主力集结松潘、张国焘延宕部队行动，中革军委 8 月 1 日放弃松潘战役，3 日改定《夏洮战役计划》，红军转向阿坝、夏河流域。
summary.en: With Hu Zongnan’s main force concentrated at Songpan and Zhang Guotao stalling, the Military Commission abandoned the Songpan campaign on 1 August and adopted the Xiatao plan on 3 August, turning toward Ngawa and the Xia river.

description.zh: 1935 年 6 月 29 日，周恩来根据中央政治局决定制定《松潘战役计划》，准备乘胡宗南部初到松潘地区、兵力尚未集中、碉堡尚未构筑完成的时机，消灭胡宗南部、控制松潘，打开北出甘南的通道。但张国焘以“组织问题”未解决为由延宕部队行动，在发布命令时把“进攻”松潘改为“佯攻”，使胡宗南部得以从容集中兵力于松潘，敌其他各部也进抵这一地区，懋功一带又被敌军占领，红军陷入腹背受敌的境地。8 月 1 日，中革军委不得不放弃松潘战役计划；红军总司令部重新调整部署，决定从 8 月 1 日起改以攻占阿坝以北夏河流域为战役目的。8 月 3 日，红军总部制定《夏（河）洮（河）战役计划》，指出松潘战役已失时机，“现特改为攻占阿坝，迅速北进夏河流域”，“以期于洮河流域消灭遭遇之蒋敌主力，形成在甘南广大地域发展之局势”，并把红一、红四方面军混编为左、右两路军。8 月 4—6 日，中央政治局在毛儿盖以南的沙窝开会，讨论的正是松潘战役未能实施所造成的局势。计划由红军总部制定，具体签发地与会议地点待考，本坐标取毛儿盖地区。
description.en: On 29 June 1935 Zhou Enlai, acting on the Politburo’s decision, drew up the Songpan campaign plan, intending to destroy Hu Zongnan’s forces and seize Songpan while they were newly arrived, un-concentrated, and without completed fortifications, thus opening the road north to southern Gansu. But Zhang Guotao stalled the troops on the pretext that the “organisational question” was unresolved and, when issuing orders, changed “attack” Songpan into a “feint,” so that Hu Zongnan could concentrate at Songpan at leisure while other Nationalist units came up and Maogong was taken, leaving the Red Army between two fires. On 1 August the Military Commission had to abandon the Songpan campaign; the Red Army headquarters readjusted, deciding that from 1 August the objective would be to take the Xia river valley north of Ngawa. On 3 August headquarters drew up the Xia (river)–Tao (river) campaign plan, noting that the Songpan campaign had lost its moment and that “it is now changed to taking Ngawa and pressing quickly north into the Xia river valley,” in order “to destroy the main force of the Chiang army encountered in the Tao river valley and create a situation for expansion over the broad area of southern Gansu,” and mixing the First and Fourth Front Armies into a Left and a Right Route Army. From 4 to 6 August the Politburo met at Shawo south of Maoergai precisely to discuss the situation created by the failure to carry out the Songpan campaign. The plan was drawn up by the Red Army headquarters; the exact place of issue and of the meetings remains to be established, and the coordinate here is a representative point for the Maoergai area.

description.en: On August 3, 1935, the Red Second and Sixth Army Groups destroyed the KMT 85th Division at Banliyuan, Xuan’en, Hubei, killing its commander Xie Bin. Unit designations and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 中央政治局在沙窝开会，重申北上方针，首次以中央文件使用“长征”一词。
summary.en: The Politburo met at Shawo, reaffirmed the northward policy, and first used the term “Long March” in a central document.

description.zh: 1935 年 8 月 4—6 日，中央政治局在毛儿盖附近沙窝（俄灯寨）召开扩大会议，讨论红一、四方面军会合后的形势与任务及组织问题；通过《关于一、四方面军会合后的政治形势与任务的决议》，重申两河口会议北上方针，强调党对红军的绝对领导和两军团结，增补陈昌浩、周纯全为政治局委员。决议中“红军一万八千里长征”是中央文件首次正式使用“长征”一词。本坐标为俄灯寨代表点。
description.en: From 4 to 6 August 1935 the Politburo held an enlarged meeting at Shawo (Edengzhai) near Maoergai to discuss the situation and tasks after the meeting of the First and Fourth Front Armies, as well as organizational questions. It adopted the “Resolution on the Political Situation and Tasks after the Meeting of the First and Fourth Front Armies”, reaffirmed the northward policy of the Lianghekou meeting, stressed absolute Party leadership over the Red Army and unity between the two armies, and added Chen Changhao and Zhou Chunquan to the Politburo. The phrase “the Red Army’s 18,000-li Long March” in the resolution was the first formal use of “Long March” in a central document. The coordinate is a representative point at Edengzhai.

name.zh: 右路军先头部队从毛儿盖出发过草地
name.en: The Right Route Army’s Advance Guard Sets Out Across the Grasslands

aliases.en: The 4th Regiment Leads Across the Grassland
Start of the First Grassland Crossing

place.zh: 四川松潘毛儿盖以北草地入口
place.en: Northern edge of Maoergai, Songpan, Sichuan, where the grasslands begin

summary.zh: 红四团与红四方面军第二九四团组成的右路军先头部队自毛儿盖出发，8 月 26 日到达班佑，为主力走出北上的路线。
summary.en: The Right Route Army’s advance guard, the 4th Regiment with the Fourth Front Army’s 294th Regiment, left Maoergai on 21 August and reached Banyou on 26 August, opening the route north for the main force.

description.zh: 1935 年 8 月 17 日清早，红四团正在开干部会，团长黄开湘接到毛泽东打来的电话：“党中央、中革军委决定红四团为先锋团，你们要在茫茫的草地上为全军走出条北上的路线来。”8 月 21 日，由红一方面军第四团和红四方面军第二九四团组成的右路军先头部队从毛儿盖出发，向班佑开进，在草地中摸索前进六天，8 月 26 日到达班佑。随后右路军第三十军于 8 月 29 日发起包座战斗，至 31 日全歼堵击的胡宗南部第四十九师，打开进军甘南的门户。主力部队穿过草地用了七天七夜，8 月底右路军全部到达班佑、巴西、阿西地区。草地行军是长征中减员最严重的一段，聂荣臻后来回忆，一军团掉队、落伍与牺牲的在四百以上。本坐标为毛儿盖以北草地入口示意点，出发地与行军路线待进一步落位。
description.en: Early on 17 August 1935, while the 4th Regiment was holding a cadre meeting, its commander Huang Kaixiang took a telephone call from Mao Zedong: “The Central Committee and the Military Commission have decided that the 4th Regiment shall be the vanguard; you must find a route north for the whole army across those vast grasslands.” On 21 August the Right Route Army’s advance guard — the First Front Army’s 4th Regiment and the Fourth Front Army’s 294th Regiment — set out from Maoergai for Banyou, feeling its way across the grassland for six days and reaching Banyou on 26 August. The 30th Army of the Right Route Army then attacked at Baozuo on 29 August, and by 31 August had wiped out the blocking 49th Division of Hu Zongnan’s army, opening the gate to southern Gansu. The main force took seven days and nights to cross the grassland, and by the end of August the whole Right Route Army had reached Banyou, Baxi, and Axi. The grassland march cost more lives than any other stage of the Long March; Nie Rongzhen later recalled that the First Army Corps alone had over 400 missing, straggling, or dead. The coordinate is a schematic point at the northern edge of Maoergai where the grassland begins; the exact starting point and route remain to be fixed.

summary.zh: 中央在巴西召开紧急会议，决定率红一、红三军连夜北上。
summary.en: The central leadership held an emergency meeting at Baxi and decided to lead the First and Third Army Corps north that night.

description.zh: 1935 年 9 月 9 日，张国焘电令右路军南下，叶剑英获取密电后报告毛泽东。毛泽东、张闻天、博古等赶到红三军团驻地巴西，连夜召开政治局紧急会议，决定率红一、红三军和军委纵队一部立即北上，脱离险境，并发布《为执行北上方针告同志书》。9 月 10 日凌晨，中央率部离开巴西，向俄界前进。本坐标为巴西镇班佑寺代表点，阿西牙弄紧急会议会址待分别落位。
description.en: On 9 September 1935 Zhang Guotao telegraphed the right column to move south. Ye Jianying obtained the telegram and reported it to Mao Zedong. Mao, Zhang Wentian, and Bo Gu rushed to the Third Army Corps headquarters at Baxi and held an emergency Politburo meeting that night. They decided to lead the First and Third Army Corps and part of the CMC column north immediately to escape the danger, and issued the “Letter to Comrades on Carrying Out the Northward Policy”. In the early hours of 10 September the central leadership left Baxi for Ejie. The coordinate is a representative point at Banyou Temple, Baxi; the Axi Yanong emergency meeting site awaits separate placement.

summary.zh: 中央政治局在俄界通过《关于张国焘同志的错误的决定》，整编陕甘支队。
summary.en: The Politburo met at Ejie, adopted the “Decision on Comrade Zhang Guotao’s Errors”, and reorganized the Shaanxi–Gansu Detachment.

description.zh: 1935 年 9 月 12 日，中央政治局在甘肃迭部俄界（今高吉村）召开扩大会议，听取毛泽东关于与四方面军领导者争论及今后战略方针的报告，通过《关于张国焘同志的错误的决定》，决定将红一、红三军和军委纵队整编为中国工农红军陕甘支队，彭德怀任司令员、毛泽东任政委，并成立由毛泽东、周恩来、王稼祥、彭德怀、林彪组成的五人团。本坐标为高吉村代表点，会址待进一步落位。
description.en: On 12 September 1935 the Politburo held an enlarged meeting at Ejie (now Gaoji Village) in Diebu, Gansu. It heard Mao Zedong’s report on the dispute with the Fourth Front Army leadership and future strategy, adopted the “Decision on Comrade Zhang Guotao’s Errors”, and decided to reorganize the First and Third Army Corps and the CMC column into the Chinese Workers’ and Peasants’ Red Army Shaanxi–Gansu Detachment, with Peng Dehuai as commander and Mao Zedong as political commissar. It also formed a five-man group of Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai, Wang Jiaxiang, Peng Dehuai, and Lin Biao. The coordinate is a representative point at Gaoji Village; the meeting site awaits further placement.

description.en: On September 15, 1935, the 25th Army reached Yongping, Yanchuan, Shaanxi, and joined the Shaanxi Red Army. On September 18 a link-up rally was held and the 15th Army Corps was proclaimed. The rally and corps founding dates follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: KMT forces held the Lazikou pass to block the Red Army’s entry into southern Gansu.

description.zh: 1935 年 9 月，国民党新编第 14 师鲁大昌部据守腊子口天险，企图阻止红军北上。红军经过激战夺取腊子口，打开进入甘南的通道。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In September 1935, the KMT New 14th Division under Lu Dachang held the natural stronghold at Lazikou to block the Red Army’s northward advance. After fierce fighting, the Red Army captured the pass and opened the route into southern Gansu. Unit designations and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 中央红军翻越六盘山后，在青石嘴击溃国民党东北军骑兵一部。
summary.en: After crossing the Liupan Mountains, the Central Red Army defeated a KMT Northeast Army cavalry unit at Qingshizui.

description.zh: 1935 年 10 月，中央红军翻越六盘山，在青石嘴击溃国民党东北军骑兵一部，扫清北上障碍。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In October 1935, the Central Red Army crossed the Liupan Mountains and defeated a KMT Northeast Army cavalry unit at Qingshizui, clearing an obstacle on its northward route. Unit designations and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 陕甘支队在青石嘴突袭东北军骑兵运输队，缴获战马百余匹。
summary.en: The Shaanxi–Gansu Detachment raided an Northeast Army cavalry supply column at Qingshizui, capturing over 100 horses.

description.zh: 1935 年 10 月 7 日，陕甘支队翻越六盘山后，前卫在青石嘴附近抓获敌军便衣侦察员，得知东北军骑兵第七师第十九团两个连正在青石嘴休整。毛泽东决定突袭，以第四大队正面攻击、第一和第五大队两翼迂回、第十三大队后卫掩护，经约半小时战斗，歼敌 200 余人，缴获战马 100 余匹及大批弹药。红军以此组建第一支骑兵侦察连。本坐标为青石嘴村代表点，具体战场待考。
description.en: On 7 October 1935, after crossing the Liupan Mountains, the Shaanxi–Gansu Detachment’s advance guard captured enemy plainclothes scouts near Qingshizui and learned that two companies of the 19th Regiment, 7th Cavalry Division, Northeast Army, were resting there. Mao Zedong ordered a surprise attack: the 4th Battalion attacked frontally, the 1st and 5th Battalions swept the flanks, and the 13th Battalion covered the rear. In about half an hour the Red Army killed or wounded more than 200 enemy soldiers and captured over 100 horses and large quantities of ammunition. The captured horses were used to form the Red Army’s first cavalry reconnaissance company. The coordinate is a representative point at Qingshizui village; the exact battlefield awaits verification.

aliases.en: First Stage of the Fourth Front Army’s Southward Move

summary.zh: 红四方面军南下，攻占绥靖、崇化、丹巴、懋功。
summary.en: The Fourth Front Army moved south and took Suijing, Chonghua, Danba, and Maogong.

description.zh: 1935 年 10 月 8 日至 20 日，红四方面军执行《绥丹崇懋战役计划》，王树声率右纵队沿大金川南下夺取绥靖、丹巴，徐向前、陈昌浩率左纵队沿抚边河南下夺取懋功、达维。经 12 天战斗，击溃川军 6 个旅，占领绥靖、崇化、丹巴、懋功等地，为南下天全、芦山打开通道。本坐标为丹巴县城代表点，绥靖、崇化、懋功待分别落位。
description.en: From 8 to 20 October 1935, the Fourth Front Army carried out the “Suidan Chongmao Campaign Plan”. Wang Shusheng led the right column south along the Dajin River to take Suijing and Danba, while Xu Xiangqian and Chen Changhao led the left column south along the Fubian River to take Maogong and Dawei. In twelve days of fighting they routed six Sichuan brigades and occupied Suijing, Chonghua, Danba, and Maogong, opening the way south to Tianquan and Lushan. The coordinate is a representative point at Danba county town; Suijing, Chonghua, and Maogong await separate placement.

summary.en: The Central Red Army reaches Wuqi in northern Shaanxi, ending the Long March.

description.zh: 1935 年 10 月 19 日，中央红军到达陕西吴起镇，与陕北红军会合，中央红军长征胜利结束。
description.en: On October 19, 1935, the Central Red Army reached Wuqi, Shaanxi, joined the Shaanxi Red Army, and brought its Long March to a victorious end.

aliases.en: Last Battle of the Long March

summary.zh: 中央红军在吴起镇击退尾追骑兵，结束长征最后一战。
summary.en: The Central Red Army defeated the pursuing cavalry at Wuqi, the last battle of the Long March.

description.zh: 1935 年 10 月 19 日，中央红军到达吴起镇，国民党军骑兵追至苏区门口。20 日，红军在头道川、平台山、二道川、三道川设伏；21 日发起“切尾巴”战役，分块切割、相机包围，歼灭东北军白凤翔第六师一个骑兵团、郭希鹏第三师两个骑兵团，击溃马鸿宾部第三十五师马培清骑兵团，毙伤 600 余人，俘 1000 余人，缴获战马、驮马 1600 余匹。此役是中央红军结束长征的最后一战。本坐标为吴起镇代表点。
description.en: On 19 October 1935 the Central Red Army reached Wuqi, with KMT cavalry pursuing to the gate of the Soviet area. On 20 October the Red Army set ambushes at Toudao Creek, Pingtai Mountain, Erdao Creek, and Sandao Creek; on 21 October it launched the “Cutting the Tail” battle, cutting the enemy into blocks and encircling them. It destroyed one cavalry regiment of Bai Fengxiang’s 6th Division and two cavalry regiments of Guo Xipeng’s 3rd Division, routed Ma Peiqing’s cavalry regiment of Ma Hongbin’s 35th Division, killed or wounded more than 600, captured more than 1,000, and took over 1,600 horses and pack animals. The battle was the last of the Central Red Army’s Long March. The coordinate is a representative point at Wuqi.

红四方面军南下第二阶段
aliases.en: Second Stage of the Fourth Front Army’s Southward Move

summary.zh: 红四方面军南下攻占宝兴、天全、芦山、名山，百丈关受挫。
summary.en: The Fourth Front Army moved south and took Baoxing, Tianquan, Lushan, and Mingshan, but was checked at Baizhang Pass.

description.zh: 1935 年 10 月 24 日至 11 月 25 日，红四方面军分左、中、右纵队从懋功、丹巴等地南下，攻占宝兴、天全、芦山、名山等地，歼敌 1 万余人，击落飞机 1 架。11 月中旬进攻百丈关，遭川军 80 余团反扑，激战 7 昼夜，伤亡近万人，被迫撤至天全、芦山、宝兴休整。此役是红四方面军南下由进攻转入防御的转折点。本坐标为芦山县城代表点。
description.en: From 24 October to 25 November 1935, the Fourth Front Army moved south in left, center, and right columns from Maogong and Danba, taking Baoxing, Tianquan, Lushan, and Mingshan, destroying more than 10,000 enemy troops, and downing one aircraft. In mid-November it attacked Baizhang Pass but was counterattacked by more than 80 Sichuan regiments; after seven days and nights of fighting it suffered nearly 10,000 casualties and withdrew to Tianquan, Lushan, and Baoxing. The campaign marked the Fourth Front Army’s shift from offensive to defensive in the south. The coordinate is a representative point at Lushan county town.

summary.en: The Red 15th Army Corps destroyed part of the KMT 107th Division at Yulinqiao.

description.zh: 1935 年 10 月 25 日，红十五军团在陕西甘泉榆林桥歼灭国民党军第 107 师第 619 团及第 620 团一部，俘团长高福源。番号与战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On October 25, 1935, the Red 15th Army Corps destroyed the 619th Regiment and part of the 620th Regiment of the KMT 107th Division at Yulinqiao, Ganquan, Shaanxi, capturing regimental commander Gao Fuyuan. Designations and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 红四方面军在百丈关与川军决战 7 昼夜，伤亡近万，南下受挫。
summary.en: The Fourth Front Army fought a seven-day decisive battle with Sichuan troops at Baizhang Pass, suffered nearly 10,000 casualties, and was checked.

description.zh: 1935 年 11 月 13 日至 21 日，红四方面军以 15 个团向名山、邛崃间百丈关进攻，16 日占领百丈镇。川军刘湘调集 80 余团，在飞机大炮掩护下从北、东、南三面反扑。红军在百丈周围十余里弧形阵地浴血苦战 7 昼夜，毙伤川军 1.5 万余人，自身伤亡近万人，被迫撤出百丈，转入防御。本坐标为百丈镇代表点。
description.en: From 13 to 21 November 1935, the Fourth Front Army attacked Baizhang Pass between Mingshan and Qionglai with fifteen regiments and took Baizhang town on 16 November. Liu Xiang concentrated more than eighty Sichuan regiments and counterattacked from north, east, and south under air and artillery cover. The Red Army fought for seven days and nights in an arc-shaped position around Baizhang, killing or wounding more than 15,000 Sichuan troops while suffering nearly 10,000 casualties, and was forced to withdraw and go on the defensive. The coordinate is a representative point at Baizhang town.
