name.en: Hunan Army and Other Forces Pursue the Red Second and Sixth Army Groups

summary.zh: 国民党军以湘军李觉纵队、中央军郭汝栋与郝梦龄等纵队分路追击红二、六军团。
summary.en: Kuomintang forces, including Li Jue’s Hunan column and the Central Army columns of Guo Rudong and Hao Mengling, pursued the Red Second and Sixth Army Groups along separate routes.

description.zh: 1935 年 11 月至 1936 年 10 月，国民党军以湘军李觉纵队、中央军郭汝栋与郝梦龄等纵队分路追击红二、六军团，企图将其围歼于湘鄂川黔地区；红军突围西进，最终与红四方面军会师。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: From November 1935 to October 1936, Kuomintang forces including Li Jue’s Hunan column and the Central Army columns of Guo Rudong and Hao Mengling pursued the Red Second and Sixth Army Groups, seeking to destroy them in the Hunan-Hubei-Sichuan-Guizhou region; the Red Army broke out westward and eventually joined the Red Fourth Front Army. Unit designations and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 直罗镇战役为党中央把革命大本营放在西北举行奠基礼。
summary.en: The Battle of Zhiluozhen lays the foundation for establishing the Party Central Committee’s base in the northwest.

description.zh: 1935 年 11 月 21 日至 24 日，红一方面军在陕西富县直罗镇歼灭国民党东北军第 109 师等部，为党中央把革命大本营放在西北奠定了基础。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: From November 21 to 24, 1935, the First Front Army destroyed the KMT Northeast Army’s 109th Division and other units at Zhiluozhen, Fu County, Shaanxi, laying the foundation for the Party Central Committee to establish its base in the northwest. Unit designations and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

place.zh: 湖南芷江便水（上坪一带）

summary.zh: 红二、红六军团在芷江便水伏击湘军第十六师，掩护西进。
summary.en: The Second and Sixth Army Corps ambushed the Hunan 16th Division at Bianshui near Zhijiang, covering their westward move.

description.zh: 1936 年 1 月 5 日至 6 日，红二、红六军团在芷江、晃县间便水地区伏击尾追的湘军李觉纵队第十六师。因敌军提前侦察、伏击意图暴露，战斗转为阵地拉锯战；红军毙伤俘敌近千人，自身亦有较大伤亡，红四师参谋长金承忠、十一团团长覃耀楚牺牲。6 日黄昏撤出战斗，向黔东转移。本坐标为便水/上坪代表点。
description.en: From 5 to 6 January 1936, the Second and Sixth Army Corps ambushed the pursuing 16th Division of Li Jue’s Hunan column at Bianshui between Zhijiang and Huangxian. Enemy reconnaissance exposed the ambush, and the battle became a positional struggle. The Red Army killed, wounded, or captured nearly 1,000 enemy troops but also suffered heavy casualties; Jin Chengzhong, chief of staff of the Fourth Division, and Qin Yaochu, commander of the 11th Regiment, were killed. The Red Army withdrew at dusk on 6 January and moved toward eastern Guizhou. The coordinate is a representative point at Bianshui/Shangping.

summary.zh: 红二、红六军团从鸭池河渡口渡过乌江上游，进占黔西。
summary.en: The Second and Sixth Army Corps crossed the upper Wu River at Yachihe and entered western Guizhou.

description.zh: 1936 年 2 月 2 日，红二、红六军团先头部队奔袭鸭池河渡口，控制南岸，缴获木船 4 只，在船工帮助下连夜架设浮桥，1.8 万余人用 3 天渡过鸭池河，进占黔西、大定、毕节，打开黔西北大门。本坐标为鸭池河古渡口代表点。
description.en: On 2 February 1936, the advance guard of the Second and Sixth Army Corps rushed the Yachihe ferry, secured the south bank, captured four wooden boats, and with local boatmen built a pontoon bridge overnight. More than 18,000 troops crossed the Yachi River over three days and entered Qianxi, Dading, and Bijie, opening the door to northwestern Guizhou. The coordinate is a representative point at the old Yachihe ferry.

aliases.en: The Fourth Front Army Moves North Again

summary.zh: 红四方面军撤离天全、芦山、宝兴，经丹巴、道孚、炉霍、甘孜二次北上。
summary.en: The Fourth Front Army withdrew from Tianquan, Lushan, and Baoxing and moved north again via Danba, Daofu, Luhuo, and Ganzi.

description.zh: 1936 年 2 月中旬，红四方面军撤离天全、芦山、宝兴地区，再次翻越夹金山，经达维、懋功、丹巴向西转移；3 月 1 日先头部队攻占道孚，15 日占炉霍，随后占领甘孜。7 月初与红二、六军团在甘孜会师，随后共同北上。本坐标为甘孜县城代表点，具体行军路线待细化。
description.en: In mid-February 1936 the Fourth Front Army withdrew from Tianquan, Lushan, and Baoxing, crossed the Jiajin Mountains again, and moved west via Dawei, Maogong, and Danba. On 1 March its advance guard took Daofu, on 15 March Luhuo, and then Ganzi. In early July it met the Second and Sixth Army Corps at Ganzi and moved north together. The coordinate is a representative point at Ganzi county town; the exact route awaits refinement.

place.zh: 贵州大方将军山、七家田一带
place.en: Jiangjunshan and Qijiatian area, Dafang, Guizhou

summary.zh: 红十七师在将军山、七家田伏击万耀煌纵队敢死队，歼其六个连。
summary.en: The 17th Division ambushed Wan Yaohuang’s dare-to-die detachment at Jiangjunshan and Qijiatian, destroying six companies.

description.zh: 1936 年 2 月 19 日上午，红六军团第十七师进至大定以西的将军山、七家田一带，发现万耀煌纵队一支六个连的敢死队沿清毕公路前进，萧克当即命令第五十五团、第五十一团从公路东侧攻击，第四十九团从西侧插入，红二军团第四师第十一团一个营及第五师一部也参加战斗。经约一个半小时激战，将该敢死队击溃，毙敌 100 余人、俘敌 300 余人，缴步枪 300 余支、轻机枪 9 挺。战后红十七师占领将军山构筑工事，阻击敌军至 2 月 26 日，掩护毕节方面休整。本坐标为将军山、七家田一带代表点。
description.en: On the morning of 19 February 1936 the 17th Division of the Sixth Army Group reached Jiangjunshan and Qijiatian west of Dading and spotted a six-company dare-to-die detachment of Wan Yaohuang’s column moving along the Qingbi highway. Xiao Ke ordered the 55th and 51st Regiments to attack from the east side of the road and the 49th Regiment to cut in from the west; one battalion of the 11th Regiment, 4th Division, Second Army Group and part of the 5th Division also took part. After about ninety minutes the detachment was routed: more than 100 enemy killed, over 300 captured, and more than 300 rifles and nine light machine guns taken. The 17th Division then occupied Jiangjunshan and built positions, holding off the enemy until 26 February to cover the rest and consolidation at Bijie. The coordinate is a representative point in the Jiangjunshan–Qijiatian area.

description.zh: 1936 年 2 月 20 日，红一方面军以中国人民红军抗日先锋军名义东渡黄河，红十五军团作为红一方面军一部参加东征，进入山西石楼、中阳一带。日期与部队关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On February 20, 1936, the First Front Army crossed the Yellow River eastward as the Chinese People’s Red Army Anti-Japanese Vanguard. The Red 15th Army Corps, as part of the First Front Army, joined the Eastern Expedition and entered the Shilou and Zhongyang areas of Shanxi. Dates and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 红二、六军团在乌蒙山区与国民党军回旋作战。
summary.en: The Red Second and Sixth Army Groups maneuvered against KMT forces in the Wumeng Mountains.

description.zh: 1936 年 2 月 27 日，红二、六军团撤离毕节，进入黔滇交界的乌蒙山区，面对国民党军五个纵队十余万人的四面合围，辗转回旋一个月、行程千余里。3 月 2 日野马川会议决定以赫章为中心与敌周旋；3 月 8 日由奎香折返，在以则河伏击樊崧甫纵队先头；3 月 9 日、10 日突破分水岭、广德关防线；3 月 12 日在哲庄坝（得章坝）伏击万耀煌第十三师；3 月 16 日第三次进入奎香，19 日从敌两个纵队接合部跳出包围圈；3 月 22 日进至宣威来宾铺，23 日在虎头山与滇军孙渡纵队激战；3 月 28 日、29 日进占盘县、亦资孔，回旋战结束。毛泽东后来评价「二、六军团在乌蒙山打转转……硬是转出来了嘛」。本坐标为赫章代表点，各次战斗另有独立点位。
description.en: On 27 February 1936 the Second and Sixth Army Groups left Bijie and entered the Wumeng Mountains on the Guizhou–Yunnan border, where five KMT columns and more than 100,000 men closed in from all sides; for a month they maneuvered over a thousand li. On 2 March the Yemachuan meeting decided to wear the enemy down around Hezhang; on 8 March the army doubled back from Kuixiang and ambushed the advance guard of Fan Songfu’s column at Yizehe; on 9–10 March it broke the Fenshuiling and Guangdeguan lines; on 12 March it ambushed Wan Yaohuang’s 13th Division at Zhezhuangba (Dezhangba); on 16 March it entered Kuixiang a third time and on 19 March slipped out through the seam between two enemy columns; on 22 March it reached Laibinpu in Xuanwei and on 23 March fought Sun Du’s Yunnan troops at Hutoushan; on 28–29 March it took Panxian and Yizikong, ending the campaign. Mao Zedong later remarked that “the Second and Sixth Army Groups went round and round in the Wumeng Mountains… and simply walked out of it.” The coordinate is a representative point at Hezhang; the individual battles have their own points.

place.zh: 四川丹巴、道孚交界党岭山夏羌涅阿垭口
place.en: Xiaqiangniea Pass, Dangling Mountain, on the Danba–Daofu border, Sichuan

summary.zh: 红四方面军先遣军翻越党岭山夏羌涅阿垭口，进占道孚。
summary.en: The Fourth Front Army’s advance guard crossed the Xiaqiangniea Pass of Dangling Mountain and took Daofu.

description.zh: 1936 年 2 月下旬，红四方面军按《康（定）道（孚）炉（霍）战役计划》分三路向康北进军。刘伯承、程世才率先遣军（以红三十军一部组成），由丹巴边耳进入党岭，2 月 27 日至 28 日翻越夏羌涅阿垭口（海拔约 4810 米），2 月 28 日进至道孚境内，3 月 1 日占领道孚县城；方面军总部 3 月 15 日翻越同垭口抵道孚。党岭主峰海拔约 5470 米，是红军长征翻越的海拔最高、牺牲最大的雪山之一。本坐标为夏羌涅阿垭口代表点。
description.en: In late February 1936 the Fourth Front Army advanced into northern Kham under the Kangding–Daofu–Luhuo campaign plan. Liu Bocheng and Cheng Shicai led an advance guard built around a portion of the 30th Army from Danba into Dangling; on 27–28 February it crossed the Xiaqiangniea Pass (about 4,810 m), reached Daofu county on 28 February, and took Daofu town on 1 March. The army headquarters crossed the same pass and reached Daofu on 15 March. Dangling’s main peak is about 5,470 m, making it one of the highest and costliest snow mountains crossed on the Long March. The coordinate is a representative point at the Xiaqiangniea Pass.

summary.zh: 红二、六军团在野马川开会，决定以赫章为中心在乌蒙山区回旋作战。
summary.en: The Second and Sixth Army Groups met at Yemachuan and decided to maneuver in the Wumeng Mountains around Hezhang.

description.zh: 1936 年 3 月 2 日，贺龙、任弼时、关向应、萧克、王震等在贵州赫章野马川召开军团领导人会议。会议分析敌我兵力对比与乌蒙山区地理、气候条件，决定以地处乌蒙山腹地的赫章为中心，在贵州赫章、威宁与云南彝良、镇雄、昭通一带迂回作战，以虚实结合、声东击西甩开追兵，再寻机向滇东转移。会议原定「继续西进、寻机南行」，3 月 4 日部队进至妈姑、回水塘时发现南进道路已被切断，遂改向西北，于 6 日进至彝良奎香。野马川会议是乌蒙山回旋战的开端。本坐标为野马川镇代表点。
description.en: On 2 March 1936 He Long, Ren Bishi, Guan Xiangying, Xiao Ke, Wang Zhen, and other army group leaders met at Yemachuan in Hezhang, Guizhou. They weighed the balance of forces and the terrain and climate of the Wumeng Mountains, and decided to make Hezhang the centre of a maneuvering campaign across Hezhang and Weining in Guizhou and Yiliang, Zhenxiong, and Zhaotong in Yunnan, using feints to throw off the pursuit before turning east into Yunnan. The meeting originally planned to continue west and then look for a way south; on 4 March, at Magu and Huishuitang, the southern road was found cut and the army turned northwest, reaching Kuixiang in Yiliang on 6 March. The Yemachuan meeting opened the Wumeng Mountains maneuvering campaign. The coordinate is a representative point at Yemachuan.

place.zh: 贵州赫章河镇乡以则村（以则河）
place.en: Yize village, Hezhen township, Hezhang, Guizhou (Yizehe)

summary.zh: 红二、六军团由奎香折返 50 里，在以则河伏击樊崧甫纵队先头。
summary.en: The Second and Sixth Army Groups doubled back 25 km from Kuixiang and ambushed the advance guard of Fan Songfu’s column at Yizehe.

description.zh: 1936 年 3 月 6 日至 7 日，红二、六军团进至云南彝良奎香一带，摆出北渡金沙江的姿态，诱使国民党军万耀煌、樊崧甫、郝梦龄三个纵队掉头西北。樊崧甫第二十八师步步紧逼，红军于 3 月 7 日夜由奎香折返约 50 里，在威宁以北、今赫章河镇乡以则村一带山地设伏。8 日拂晓，敌第二十八师先头部队进入伏击圈，红四师、红十六师、红十七师一齐开火，歼其先头两个连，毙伤俘敌数百人（另有「重创 600 余人」说），迫使该敌不敢轻进。战斗后红军迅速返回奎香，并于 3 月 9 日、10 日突破分水岭、广德关两道防线。本坐标为以则村代表点。
description.en: On 6–7 March 1936 the Second and Sixth Army Groups reached the Kuixiang area of Yiliang, Yunnan, posing as if about to cross the Jinsha River northward, which drew the columns of Wan Yaohuang, Fan Songfu, and Hao Mengling back to the northwest. Fan Songfu’s 28th Division pressed close; on the night of 7 March the Red Army doubled back about 25 km from Kuixiang and set an ambush in the hills north of Weining, around present-day Yize village in Hezhen township, Hezhang. At dawn on 8 March the division’s advance guard entered the trap and the 4th, 16th, and 17th Divisions opened fire together, destroying two leading companies and killing, wounding, or capturing several hundred (some accounts say over 600), which checked the enemy’s pursuit. The Red Army then returned swiftly to Kuixiang and on 9–10 March broke through the Fenshuiling and Guangdeguan defence lines. The coordinate is a representative point at Yize village.

sources.title: 《乌蒙山回旋战：绝境之中闯生路》

place.zh: 贵州赫章哲庄镇（得章坝，镇雄以南）
place.en: Zhezhuang (Dezhangba), Hezhang, Guizhou, south of Zhenxiong

summary.zh: 红二、六军团在哲庄坝（得章坝）伏击万耀煌第十三师，歼其两个团。
summary.en: The Second and Sixth Army Groups ambushed Wan Yaohuang’s 13th Division at Zhezhuangba (Dezhangba), destroying two regiments.

description.zh: 1936 年 3 月 11 日，红二军团第四师进抵镇雄城外以萨沟，获悉万耀煌纵队第十三师经哲庄坝（又称得章坝，今赫章县哲庄镇）向镇雄前进。12 日凌晨，红军分三路进入伏击阵地：一路由巴基山梁子至三锅庄、雨子场，一路由古基至哲庄、黄家营盘，一路由大屋基梁子至桃园垭口。9 时许，敌第十三师进入伏击圈，红军自西侧制高点拦腰截断，与敌短兵相接、反复肉搏十余次，万耀煌换装混杂于溃兵中逃脱。此役歼敌两个团、俘敌 200 余人，缴获轻重机枪 30 余挺（另有「歼敌 300 余人」「击溃第十三师」等口径）。红六师第十八团政委余秋里在战斗中负重伤，失去左臂。伏击战后红军被五个纵队围困于镇雄、赫章间狭小地域，3 月 16 日第三次进入奎香，19 日跳出包围圈。本坐标为哲庄镇代表点。
description.en: On 11 March 1936 the Second Army Corps’ 4th Division reached Yisagou outside Zhenxiong and learned that Wan Yaohuang’s 13th Division was moving toward Zhenxiong via Zhezhuangba (also called Dezhangba, present-day Zhezhuang in Hezhang). Before dawn on 12 March the Red Army moved into ambush positions in three routes: from Baji ridge to Sanguozhuang and Yuzichang, from Guji to Zhezhuang and Huangjiayingpan, and from Dawuji ridge to Taoyuan pass. At about 9 a.m. the 13th Division entered the trap; the Red Army cut it in two from the heights to the west and fought hand to hand more than ten times, while Wan Yaohuang changed clothes and escaped among the routed troops. Two regiments were destroyed, over 200 captured, and more than 30 light and heavy machine guns taken (other accounts give over 300 casualties or describe the 13th Division as routed). Yu Qiuli, commissar of the 18th Regiment of the 6th Division, was gravely wounded and lost his left arm. After the ambush five enemy columns confined the Red Army in a narrow area between Zhenxiong and Hezhang; it entered Kuixiang a third time on 16 March and broke out on 19 March. The coordinate is a representative point at Zhezhuang.

place.zh: 云南宣威来宾铺（今来宾街道）、虎头山一带
place.en: Laibinpu (present-day Laibin) and Hutoushan, Xuanwei, Yunnan

summary.zh: 红二、六军团在来宾铺虎头山与滇军孙渡纵队激战，歼敌 400 余人。
summary.en: The Second and Sixth Army Groups fought Sun Du’s Yunnan troops at Hutoushan near Laibinpu, killing or wounding over 400.

description.zh: 1936 年 3 月 22 日，红二、六军团到达云南宣威东北的来宾铺、徐屯地区。3 月 23 日，红军在来宾铺城北虎头山一带与滇军孙渡纵队激战竟日，歼敌 400 余人（另有歼敌近千人的记载，待核），自身亦有较大伤亡。战后红军沿乌蒙山东麓继续南下，3 月 28 日、29 日先后进占盘县、亦资孔地区，乌蒙山回旋战结束；3 月 30 日在盘县「九间楼」召开盘县会议，决定北渡金沙江。来宾铺战斗后，红二、六军团放弃了在滇东创建根据地的计划。本坐标为来宾街道代表点。
description.en: On 22 March 1936 the Second and Sixth Army Groups reached Laibinpu and Xutun northeast of Xuanwei, Yunnan. On 23 March they fought Sun Du’s Yunnan column all day around Hutoushan north of Laibinpu, killing or wounding more than 400 (some accounts give nearly a thousand, pending verification) and suffering considerable casualties themselves. The army then moved south along the eastern foot of the Wumeng Mountains, occupying Panxian and Yizikong on 28–29 March and ending the Wumeng Mountains campaign; on 30 March the Panxian meeting at the “Nine-Room Tower” decided to cross the Jinsha River northward. After Laibinpu the Second and Sixth Army Groups abandoned the plan to build a base in eastern Yunnan. The coordinate is a representative point at Laibin.

summary.zh: 红二、红六军团在盘县九间楼开会，决定北渡金沙江与红四方面军会合。
summary.en: The Second and Sixth Army Corps met at Jiujianlou in Panxian and decided to cross the Jinsha River north to join the Fourth Front Army.

description.zh: 1936 年 3 月 30 日夜，红二、红六军团在盘县九间楼召开会议，传达红军总部电示，分析全国形势，决定放弃在南北盘江建立根据地，立即北渡金沙江，与红四方面军会合、共同北上抗日。4 月 1 日撤离盘县。本坐标为九间楼代表点。
description.en: On the night of 30 March 1936, the Second and Sixth Army Corps met at Jiujianlou in Panxian. They relayed the Red Army headquarters’ instructions, analyzed the national situation, and decided to abandon plans for a base between the north and south Pan rivers. Instead they would cross the Jinsha River north to join the Fourth Front Army and move north together to resist Japan. They left Panxian on 1 April. The coordinate is a representative point at Jiujianlou.

place.zh: 四川道孚麻孜乡西南亚洛阔山垭口
place.en: Yalokuo Mountain pass southwest of Mazi township, Daofu, Sichuan

summary.zh: 红四军第十师由道孚麻孜乡翻越亚洛阔山，开始四天奔袭瞻化。
summary.en: The 10th Division of the 4th Army crossed Yalokuo Mountain from Mazi, Daofu, beginning the four-day rush on Zhanhua.

description.zh: 1936 年 3 月 27 日，红四方面军第四军奉命以第十师、第十一师由道孚奔袭瞻化（今新龙），限速夺取县城。4 月 1 日，第十师经麻孜乡（陈伯钧日记记为「麻子沟」）翻越亚洛阔山垭口（图测海拔约 4510 米）西进，当日行约六十里至热里科喇嘛寺宿营。部分资料将这一段四座垭口记为决益涅阿、伊则涅阿、伊涅阿、俄里涅阿，名称与对应关系尚待考证。本坐标为亚洛阔山垭口代表点。
description.en: On 27 March 1936 the 4th Army of the Fourth Front Army was ordered to rush Zhanhua (present-day Xinlong) with its 10th and 11th Divisions from Daofu and take the county town at speed. On 1 April the 10th Division crossed the Yalokuo Mountain pass (mapped at about 4,510 m) from Mazi township (recorded as “Mazigou” in Chen Bojun’s diary) and marched some sixty li west to camp at Relike Lamasery. Some sources record the four passes of this stretch as Jueyi Niea, Yize Niea, Yi Niea, and Eli Niea; the names and their correspondence still require verification. The coordinate is a representative point at the Yalokuo pass.

place.en: Shayong Mountain pass between Mazi and Jiasikong townships, Daofu, Sichuan

summary.zh: 红四军第十师经亚洛阔旧寺翻越沙拥山，向甲斯孔河前进。
summary.en: The 10th Division crossed Shayong Mountain past Yalokuo Monastery and moved toward the Jiasikong River.

description.zh: 1936 年 4 月 2 日，红四军第十师由热里科喇嘛寺继续西进，经亚洛阔旧寺翻越沙拥山垭口（图测海拔约 4700 米）前往甲斯孔河畔，当日行约五十里至甲子孔。陈伯钧日记称「今日的山与党岭不相上下」，可见积雪与海拔之高。本坐标为沙拥山垭口代表点。
description.en: On 2 April 1936 the 10th Division moved west from Relike Lamasery, passed Yalokuo Monastery, and crossed the Shayong Mountain pass (mapped at about 4,700 m) toward the Jiasikong River, marching about fifty li to Jiazikong. Chen Bojun’s diary notes that “today’s mountain was comparable to Dangling,” indicating deep snow and high elevation. The coordinate is a representative point at the Shayong pass.

place.zh: 四川道孚麻孜乡与新龙拉日马乡交界伊涅阿山垭口
place.en: Yijiea Mountain pass on the Daofu–Xinlong border, Sichuan

summary.zh: 红四军第十师翻越伊涅阿山，进入拉日马一带。
summary.en: The 10th Division crossed Yijiea Mountain into the Larima area.

description.zh: 1936 年 4 月 3 日，红四军第十师由甲子孔继续西进，经沙拥村翻越伊涅阿山垭口（图测海拔约 4616 米），当日行约四十里至腊科。伊涅阿山是道孚与新龙的界山，藏语意为「向阳的山垭」，当地又称「丹巴达吉」。本坐标为伊涅阿山垭口代表点。
description.en: On 3 April 1936 the 10th Division continued west from Jiazikong, passed Shayong village, and crossed the Yijiea Mountain pass (mapped at about 4,616 m), marching about forty li to Lako. Yijiea Mountain forms the border between Daofu and Xinlong; its Tibetan name means “sunny pass,” and it is also called “Danba Daji” locally. The coordinate is a representative point at the Yijiea pass.

place.zh: 四川新龙甲拉乡东南扎巴加山垭口
place.en: Zhabajia Mountain pass southeast of Jiala township, Xinlong, Sichuan

summary.zh: 红四军第十师翻越扎巴加山，直抵瞻化县城。
summary.en: The 10th Division crossed Zhabajia Mountain and reached Zhanhua county town.

description.zh: 1936 年 4 月 4 日，红四军第十师由腊科出发，行约五十里进沟，再翻越扎巴加山垭口（实测海拔约 4590 米）行约九十里，当晚抵达瞻化（今新龙）县城并投入战斗，夜十时攻破县城。扎巴加山藏语意为「带回声的山」，当地又称「梁阿卡山」。至此，红四军四天连续翻越四座海拔 4000 米以上雪山，完成高原长途奔袭。本坐标为扎巴加山垭口代表点。
description.en: On 4 April 1936 the 10th Division left Lako, marched about fifty li up the valley, crossed the Zhabajia Mountain pass (surveyed at about 4,590 m), and covered another ninety li to reach Zhanhua (present-day Xinlong) county town that evening, attacking at once and breaking into the town at 10 p.m. The Tibetan name of Zhabajia means “mountain that returns an echo,” and it is also called “Liangaka.” The 4th Army thus crossed four passes above 4,000 m in four consecutive days, completing a long-distance highland raid. The coordinate is a representative point at the Zhabajia pass.

aliases.en: Seizing the Yalong River Chain Bridge

summary.zh: 红四军第十师夜袭瞻化县城，打开北上通道。
summary.en: The 10th Division stormed Zhanhua county town at night, opening the northward route.

description.zh: 1936 年 4 月 4 日，红四军第十师经四天连续翻越四座雪山抵达瞻化（今新龙）县城，几乎未作停顿即投入战斗，当晚十时攻破县城，并夺取雅砻江铁索桥。此役打开了红四方面军北上甘孜的通道，被视为高原山地长途奔袭的典型战例。战斗中红军亦有一定伤亡，具体数字待核。本坐标为瞻化县城代表点。
description.en: On 4 April 1936 the 10th Division of the 4th Army reached Zhanhua (present-day Xinlong) county town after crossing four snow mountains in four days. It attacked almost without pause, broke into the town at 10 p.m., and seized the chain bridge over the Yalong River. The action opened the Fourth Front Army’s route north to Garzê and is regarded as a classic long-distance highland raid. The Red Army also suffered casualties; the exact number requires verification. The coordinate is a representative point at Zhanhua county town.

place.en: Pudu River chain bridge, Luquan, Yunnan

summary.zh: 红二军团抢占普渡河渡口，与滇军激战，渡河受阻。
summary.en: The Second Army Corps seized the Pudu River crossing and fought the Yunnan army, but the crossing was blocked.

description.zh: 1936 年 4 月 8 日，红二军团第四师先头部队抢占禄劝普渡河渡口，与滇军孙渡纵队激战；红四师大部从铁索桥下涉水过河，红六军团前卫第十七师在普渡河与滇军遭遇，渡河受阻。红军被迫调整部署，转至六甲阻击。本坐标为普渡河铁索桥代表点。
description.en: On 8 April 1936, the advance guard of the Fourth Division, Second Army Corps, seized the Pudu River crossing in Luquan and fought Sun Du’s Yunnan column. Most of the Fourth Division forded the river below the chain bridge, while the Seventeenth Division, vanguard of the Sixth Army Corps, met the Yunnan troops at the Pudu River and was blocked. The Red Army adjusted its deployment and turned to block the enemy at Liujia. The coordinate is a representative point at the Pudu River chain bridge.

summary.zh: 红六师在六甲阻击滇军，掩护主力西进。
summary.en: The Sixth Division blocked the Yunnan army at Liujia, covering the main force’s westward move.

description.zh: 1936 年 4 月 9 日，红二军团第六师在寻甸六甲石蜡坨垭口阻击尾追的滇军第七旅，红十六、十七、十八团抢占垭口南北山冈，激战至傍晚，红五师增援从侧后夹击，滇军溃退。红军以伤亡 200 余人代价歼敌近千人，粉碎滇军将红军消灭于普渡河以东、功山以南的计划。本坐标为六甲/贾白山代表点。
description.en: On 9 April 1936, the Sixth Division of the Second Army Corps blocked the pursuing 7th Brigade of the Yunnan army at the Shilatuo pass in Liujia, Xundian. The 16th, 17th, and 18th Regiments seized the high ground north and south of the pass and fought until evening, when the Fifth Division arrived and attacked the enemy flank and rear, routing the Yunnan troops. The Red Army suffered more than 200 casualties and killed or wounded nearly 1,000 enemy soldiers, foiling the plan to destroy the Red Army east of the Pudu River and south of Gongshan. The coordinate is a representative point at Liujia/Jiabaishan.

description.en: Around April 25, 1936, the Red Second and Sixth Army Groups crossed the Jinsha River at Shigu, Lijiang, Yunnan, and headed north to link up.

place.zh: 云南香格里拉上江、小中甸之间雅哈雪山
place.en: Yaha Snow Mountain between Shangjiang and Xiaozhongdian, Shangri-La, Yunnan

summary.zh: 红二、红六军团渡金沙江后翻越雅哈雪山，进入中甸藏区。
summary.en: After crossing the Jinsha River, the Second and Sixth Army Groups crossed Yaha Snow Mountain into the Zhongdian Tibetan area.

description.zh: 1936 年 4 月 25 日至 28 日，红二、红六军团在石鼓至巨甸一线渡过金沙江，随后沿玉龙雪山西麓北上。4 月 28 日，红二军团第四师前卫第十二团经上江、立马河翻越雅哈雪山，在干岩房遭中甸头人汪学鼎民团阻击，红军有伤亡；红军未直接还击，以密集火力压制、驱散民团。4 月 30 日先头部队进入中甸县城，红二军团直属队及第五、第六师于 5 月 1 日、3 日先后到达。雅哈雪山海拔诸说不一，有 5300 米、3924 米与约 4000 米等说法，本数据不取单一数值。本坐标为雅哈雪山垭口代表点。
description.en: From 25 to 28 April 1936 the Second and Sixth Army Groups crossed the Jinsha River between Shigu and Judian and moved north along the western foot of Yulong Snow Mountain. On 28 April the 12th Regiment, forward unit of the 4th Division, Second Army Group, crossed Yaha Snow Mountain via Shangjiang and Limahé. At Ganyanfang it was ambushed by the militia of the Zhongdian headman Wang Xueding and suffered casualties; the Red Army did not return fire directly and dispersed the militia with heavy fire over their heads. The advance guard entered Zhongdian town on 30 April; the Second Army Group headquarters and the 5th and 6th Divisions arrived on 1 and 3 May. Published elevations for Yaha vary widely (5,300 m, 3,924 m, and about 4,000 m), so this entry does not adopt a single figure. The coordinate is a representative point at the Yaha pass.

name.en: Crossing the Greater and Lesser Snow Mountains

place.zh: 云南香格里拉与四川乡城交界大、小雪山垭口
place.en: Greater and Lesser Snow Mountain passes on the Yunnan–Sichuan border, Shangri-La / Xiangcheng

summary.zh: 红六军团由中甸翻越大、小雪山，进入四川乡城。
summary.en: The Sixth Army Group crossed the Greater and Lesser Snow Mountains from Zhongdian into Xiangcheng, Sichuan.

description.zh: 1936 年 5 月 5 日，红二、红六军团由中甸分两路北进：红二军团经得荣、巴安（今巴塘）、白玉，红六军团经定乡（今乡城）、稻城、理化（今理塘）、瞻化（今新龙）至甘孜。5 月 9 日，红六军团由中甸出发，翻越大雪山（咱浪雪山，垭口海拔约 4333 米）与小雪山（甲子雪山，垭口海拔约 4185 米）进入乡城境内；5 月 14 日到达定乡，受到桑披寺僧众接待并休整一周。两山垭口同在一道山脊，常被视作一座雪山。本坐标为两垭口之间的代表点。
description.en: On 5 May 1936 the Second and Sixth Army Groups left Zhongdian on two routes: the Second Army Group via Derong, Batang, and Baiyü; the Sixth via Xiangcheng, Daocheng, Litang, and Xinlong to Garzê. On 9 May the Sixth Army Group crossed the Greater Snow Mountain (Zanlang, pass about 4,333 m) and the Lesser Snow Mountain (Jiazi, pass about 4,185 m) into Xiangcheng county, reaching Xiangcheng town on 14 May, where it was received by the Sangpi Monastery and rested for a week. The two passes lie on the same ridge and are often treated as one snow mountain. The coordinate is a representative point between the two passes.

place.zh: 四川巴塘中咱乡月日茨普垭口
place.en: Yuericipu Pass, Zhongzan township, Batang, Sichuan

summary.zh: 红二军团经波茨翻越月日茨普，进入巴塘中咱。
summary.en: The Second Army Group crossed the Yuericipu Pass via Bozi and entered Zhongzan in Batang.

description.zh: 1936 年 5 月 15 日，从得荣北进的红二军团经巴塘县波茨翻越月日茨普垭口（图测海拔约 4579 米），进入中咱乡境。「月日茨普」藏语意为「亮水头」，因草场之水源于冰川、源头晶莹耀眼而得名。5 月 20 日，红二军团先头第四师在巴塘南部茨巫乡与仁波喇嘛寺武装僧兵接火，红军围而不打、晓以大义，随后经中咱向巴安（今巴塘）前进。本坐标为月日茨普垭口代表点。
description.en: On 15 May 1936 the Second Army Group, moving north from Derong, crossed the Yuericipu Pass (mapped at about 4,579 m) via Bozi in Batang county and entered Zhongzan township. The Tibetan name means “bright water head,” after the glacier-fed streams there. On 20 May the advance 4th Division clashed with armed monks of Renbo Monastery at Ciwu in southern Batang; the Red Army surrounded them without attacking and persuaded them to stand down, then advanced via Zhongzan toward Batang. The coordinate is a representative point at the Yuericipu pass.

summary.en: Kuomintang forces under Ma Hongkui, Ma Hongbin and other Gansu-Ningxia-Qinghai units blocked the Western Expedition.

description.zh: 1936 年 5 月至 7 月，国民党军以马鸿逵、马鸿宾等甘宁青部队堵截西征红军，红军在盐池、同心一带与敌周旋。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: From May to July 1936, Kuomintang forces under Ma Hongkui, Ma Hongbin and other Gansu-Ningxia-Qinghai units blocked the Western Expedition as the Red Army maneuvered around Yanchi and Tongxin. Unit designations and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 红六军团由乡城翻越沙鲁里山，进入稻城桑堆。
summary.en: The Sixth Army Group crossed the Shaluli Mountains from Xiangcheng into Sangdui, Daocheng.

description.zh: 1936 年 5 月 20 日，红六军团由乡城出发，翻越乡城与稻城交界、当地称「无名山」的沙鲁里山垭口（图测海拔约 4730 米），进入稻城县桑堆乡，5 月 22 日进驻稻城县城。此后经理化（今理塘）北上，6 月 3 日在甲洼与红四方面军第三十二军会师。本坐标为沙鲁里山垭口代表点。
description.en: On 20 May 1936 the Sixth Army Group left Xiangcheng and crossed the Shaluli Mountain pass on the Xiangcheng–Daocheng border, locally called the “Nameless Mountain” (mapped at about 4,730 m), entering Sangdui township in Daocheng county and reaching Daocheng town on 22 May. It then moved north via Litang and met the 32nd Army of the Fourth Front Army at Jiawa on 3 June. The coordinate is a representative point at the Shaluli pass.

place.en: Zangbala Mountain pass between Yarigong and Batang town, Sichuan

summary.zh: 红二军团翻越藏巴拉山，进至巴塘县城附近。
summary.en: The Second Army Group crossed Zangbala Mountain and approached Batang town.

description.zh: 1936 年 6 月 5 日，经亚日贡向巴塘北进的红二军团翻越藏巴拉山垭口（图测海拔约 4900 米），进至巴塘县城附近。红二军团随后佯攻巴塘、主力绕城北进，6 月 14 日撤离巴塘向白玉进发，6 月 30 日到达甘孜绒巴岔，与红四方面军会合。藏巴拉山是红二军团（后编为红二方面军）长征中翻越的海拔最高的雪山之一。本坐标为藏巴拉山垭口代表点。
description.en: On 5 June 1936 the Second Army Group, moving north via Yarigong toward Batang, crossed the Zangbala Mountain pass (mapped at about 4,900 m) and approached Batang town. It then feinted against Batang while the main force bypassed the town to the north, withdrew toward Baiyü on 14 June, and reached Rongbacha in Garzê on 30 June to join the Fourth Front Army. Zangbala is among the highest snow mountains crossed by the Second Army Group (later the Second Front Army) on the Long March. The coordinate is a representative point at the Zangbala pass.

summary.zh: 红二军团一部由巴塘北进，翻越恶热拉山进至白玉。
summary.en: Part of the Second Army Group crossed the Ere Pass from Batang toward Baiyü.

description.zh: 1936 年 6 月 14 日，红二军团撤离巴塘向白玉进发。6 月 18 日，部队兵分两路：一路经恶热拉山垭口（图测海拔约 4636 米）北进。「恶热拉」藏语意为「头巾山」。两路于白玉县城会合，6 月 19 日进驻白玉，休整五天。本坐标为恶热拉山垭口代表点。
description.en: On 14 June 1936 the Second Army Group left Batang for Baiyü. On 18 June it split into two columns: one crossed the Ere Mountain pass (mapped at about 4,636 m). The Tibetan name means “headscarf mountain.” The two columns reunited at Baiyü county town and entered it on 19 June, resting for five days. The coordinate is a representative point at the Ere pass.

summary.zh: 红二军团另一部翻越麦拉山，与恶热拉一路会合于白玉。
summary.en: Another column of the Second Army Group crossed Maila Mountain and joined the Ere column at Baiyü.

description.zh: 1936 年 6 月 18 日，由巴塘北进的红二军团兵分两路，另一路经麦拉山垭口（图测海拔约 4340 米）北进。「麦拉」藏语意为「黑痣山」，垭口位于绒玉乡与盖玉乡交界。两路于白玉县城会合，6 月 19 日进驻白玉。本坐标为麦拉山垭口代表点。
description.en: On 18 June 1936 the Second Army Group, moving north from Batang, split into two columns; the other crossed the Maila Mountain pass (mapped at about 4,340 m). The Tibetan name means “black mole mountain,” and the pass lies on the border between Rongyü and Gaiyü townships. The two columns reunited at Baiyü county town and entered it on 19 June. The coordinate is a representative point at the Maila pass.

summary.zh: 红二军团翻越生欧拉山，进至甘孜绒巴岔与红四方面军会合。
summary.en: The Second Army Group crossed Sheng’oula Mountain and reached Rongbacha in Garzê to join the Fourth Front Army.

description.zh: 1936 年 6 月 25 日，红二军团由白玉经嘎拖寺、河坡、赠科向甘孜挺进；6 月 30 日翻越白玉与甘孜界山生欧拉山垭口（图测海拔约 4767 米），进至甘孜绒巴岔，与红四方面军第三十军第八十八师及当地群众会合。「生欧拉」藏语意为「哭泣的山」。7 月 1 日，红二、红六军团齐集甘孜甘海子，与红四方面军会师。本坐标为生欧拉山垭口代表点。
description.en: On 25 June 1936 the Second Army Group moved from Baiyü toward Garzê via Gathok Monastery, Hepo, and Zengkê. On 30 June it crossed the Sheng’oula Mountain pass (mapped at about 4,767 m) on the Baiyü–Garzê border and reached Rongbacha in Garzê, joining the 88th Division of the Fourth Front Army’s 30th Army and local people. The Tibetan name means “weeping mountain.” On 1 July the Second and Sixth Army Groups assembled at Ganhaizi near Garzê and met the Fourth Front Army. The coordinate is a representative point at the Sheng’oula pass.

summary.zh: 红四方面军发起岷洮西固战役，攻占临潭、漳县、渭源、通渭等地。
summary.en: The Fourth Front Army launched the Min–Tao–Xigu campaign, taking Lintan, Zhangxian, Weiyuan, Tongwei, and surrounding areas.

description.zh: 1936 年 8 月 5 日，中共中央西北局在求吉寺会议后发布《岷洮西固战役计划》，红四方面军分两纵队由包座北上，先机夺取岷州（今岷县）、洮州（今临潭）、西固（今舟曲）地区。战役至 9 月 7 日结束，历时 34 天，先后攻占漳县、临潭、渭源、通渭四座县城及岷县、陇西、临洮、武山、宕昌等县广大农村，共歼敌 7000 余人。岷县县城久攻未克，红军改取围而不打，主力绕城北上。此役打开了红二、四方面军北上的通道。本坐标为岷县代表点；西固方向为战役分支，未单独建模。
description.en: On 5 August 1936, after the Qiuji Monastery meeting, the Northwest Bureau issued the Min–Tao–Xigu campaign plan. The Fourth Front Army moved north from Bazuo in two columns to seize Minzhou (present-day Minxian), Taozhou (Lintan), and Xigu (Zhouqu). The campaign ended on 7 September after 34 days, taking Zhangxian, Lintan, Weiyuan, and Tongwei county towns and large rural areas of Minxian, Longxi, Lintao, Wushan, and Dangchang, with more than 7,000 enemy troops killed or wounded. Minxian town was not taken; the Red Army switched to containing it and moved its main force around it to the north. The campaign opened the route north for the Second and Fourth Front Armies. The coordinate is a representative point at Minxian; the Xigu branch is not modelled separately.

summary.zh: 红三十军第八十八师夜袭腊子口，打开北上甘南门户。
summary.en: The 88th Division of the 30th Army took Lazikou by night attack, opening the gate to southern Gansu.

description.zh: 1936 年 8 月 8 日夜，红四方面军第三十军第八十八师进攻腊子口，以两个营正面佯攻、一个营侧后迂回，加上一年前陕甘支队攻克腊子口的声威，迅速击垮国民党鲁大昌部守军一个营。8 月 9 日红军突破腊子口进入岷县境内，北上门户打开。此次战斗与 1935 年 9 月中央红军攻克腊子口是两次不同行动。本坐标为腊子口代表点。
description.en: On the night of 8 August 1936 the 88th Division of the Fourth Front Army’s 30th Army attacked Lazikou, feinting frontally with two battalions and sending one battalion around the flank. Together with the prestige of the Shaanxi–Gansu Detachment’s capture of Lazikou a year earlier, the attack quickly broke a battalion of Lu Dachang’s defenders. On 9 August the Red Army passed Lazikou into Minxian county, opening the northern gate. This action is distinct from the Central Red Army’s capture of Lazikou in September 1935. The coordinate is a representative point at Lazikou.

place.zh: 甘肃岷县县城南二郎山
place.en: Erlangshan south of Minxian county town, Gansu

summary.zh: 红三十军猛攻岷县二郎山，激战六昼夜后改强攻为围困。
summary.en: The 30th Army assaulted Erlangshan at Minxian for six days and nights before switching to containment.

description.zh: 1936 年 8 月 10 日晚 11 时，红四方面军第三十军向岷县县城屏障二郎山发起猛攻，徐向前、陈昌浩、程世才、李先念等指挥，红军四次突破敌第三号碉堡，并在张家坪与敌特务团巷战。战斗反复拉锯，前沿阵地七次易手；鲁大昌急调两营增援。激战六昼夜，红军毙伤敌 1500 余人（另有 2000 余人说），缴轻重机枪 11 挺、迫击炮 5 门，自身伤亡 1000 余人。因城垣坚固、缺乏攻坚武器且部队刚出草地，红军改强攻为佯攻，以少数兵力围困县城，主力休整并做群众工作。本坐标为二郎山代表点。
description.en: At 11 p.m. on 10 August 1936 the Fourth Front Army’s 30th Army assaulted Erlangshan, the natural shield of Minxian town, under Xu Xiangqian, Chen Changhao, Cheng Shicai, and Li Xiannian. The Red Army broke into the enemy’s No. 3 blockhouse four times and fought street actions against the special service regiment at Zhangjiaping. The front line changed hands seven times, and Lu Dachang rushed two battalions as reinforcements. After six days and nights the Red Army had killed or wounded more than 1,500 enemy troops (some accounts say over 2,000), captured 11 light and heavy machine guns and five mortars, and suffered over 1,000 casualties. With strong walls, little siege equipment, and troops exhausted from the grasslands, the Red Army switched from assault to feint, containing the town with a small force while the main force rested and worked among the people. The coordinate is a representative point at Erlangshan.

summary.zh: 红四军第十师与妇女独立团攻占临潭旧城，随后阻击马彪旅。
summary.en: The 10th Division and the Women’s Independent Regiment took Lintan old town, then blocked Ma Biao’s brigade.

description.zh: 1936 年 8 月 20 日拂晓前，红四军第十师和妇女独立团沿山梁大道逼近洮州旧城；8 月 22 日发起攻击，攻占瓦窑坪、双峰堆，次日夺取对坡山、大坡山顶、大湾山梁制高点，击溃「铲共义勇团」，占领旧城，全歼守敌一个营，缴枪 300 余支，俘敌数十名。8 月 23 日，马步芳部马彪旅猛攻旧城，红军在旧城郊口、八龙河一带阻击。随后红军撤至新城方向。本坐标为临潭旧城代表点。
description.en: Before dawn on 20 August 1936 the 10th Division of the 4th Army and the Women’s Independent Regiment advanced on Taozhou old town along the ridge road. On 22 August they attacked, taking Wayaoping and Shuangfengdui, and the next day seized the heights at Duiposhan, Daposhan, and Dawan ridge, routed the “Communist Suppression Volunteers,” and occupied the old town. A garrison battalion was destroyed, over 300 rifles and several dozen prisoners taken. On 23 August Ma Biao’s brigade of Ma Bufang’s forces attacked; the Red Army blocked it at the town outskirts and along the Balong River, then withdrew toward Xincheng. The coordinate is a representative point at Lintan old town.

summary.zh: 红二方面军十天奔袭七百余里，攻占成县、徽县、两当、康县。
summary.en: In ten days the Second Front Army marched over 700 li and took Chengxian, Huixian, Liangdang, and Kangxian.

description.zh: 1936 年 9 月 11 日至 20 日，红二方面军按《成徽两康战役计划》分左、中、右三路纵队由哈达铺地区东出陇南，十天行程七百余里。左纵队红六军 9 月 18 日攻占徽县、两当（两当由地下工作者配合智取，俘保安队和警察 97 人，缴枪 200 余支）；中纵队红二军第四师、红三十二军 9 月 18 日拂晓攻占成县，守敌一个营被歼，缴枪 300 余支；右纵队红二军第六师 9 月 19 日占领康县。战役共攻占四座县城及西和、礼县、武都、略阳、凤县部分地区，为创建陇南临时根据地和三大主力会师创造了条件。本坐标为成县代表点。
description.en: From 11 to 20 September 1936 the Second Front Army executed the Cheng–Hui–Liang–Kang plan, moving east from the Hadapu area in three columns and covering over 700 li in ten days. The left column (Sixth Army) took Huixian and Liangdang on 18 September; Liangdang was taken by stealth with underground contacts, capturing 97 security men and police and over 200 rifles. The centre column (4th Division of the Second Army and the 32nd Army) took Chengxian at dawn on 18 September, destroying a garrison battalion and capturing over 300 rifles. The right column (6th Division) took Kangxian on 19 September. The campaign seized four county towns and parts of Xihe, Lixian, Wudu, Lueyang, and Fengxian, creating conditions for the Longnan base area and the three armies’ rendezvous. The coordinate is a representative point at Chengxian.

aliases.zh: 中共中央西北局岷州会议

summary.zh: 中共中央西北局在岷州开会，否定西进主张，通过《静会战役纲领》。
summary.en: The Northwest Bureau met at Minzhou, rejected the westward plan, and adopted the Jingning–Huining campaign outline.

description.zh: 1936 年 9 月 16 日至 18 日，中共中央西北局在岷县三十里铺召开会议。张国焘坚持红四方面军由临潭西进青海、占领甘西；朱德、陈昌浩等主张执行中央指示，北上静宁、会宁地区与红一方面军会合。会议最终否定西进主张，通过《静会战役纲领》，9 月 18 日由朱德、张国焘、陈昌浩联名电告党中央。岷州会议是三大主力会师前的关键一步。本坐标为三十里铺会址代表点。
description.en: From 16 to 18 September 1936 the Northwest Bureau of the CPC Central Committee met at Sanshilipu in Minxian. Zhang Guotao insisted that the Fourth Front Army move west from Lintan into Qinghai; Zhu De and Chen Changhao argued for obeying the Central Committee and moving north to the Jingning–Huining area to join the First Front Army. The meeting rejected the westward plan and adopted the Jingning–Huining campaign outline, which Zhu De, Zhang Guotao, and Chen Changhao reported to the Central Committee on 18 September. The Minzhou meeting was a key step toward the three armies’ rendezvous. The coordinate is a representative point at the Sanshilipu site.

sources.title: 《三大主力红军胜利会师前的战斗》
sources.author: 中国军网
sources.note: 用于核对通庄静会部署与三大主力会师过程

place.zh: 甘肃成县抛沙镇五龙山、新堡山
place.en: Wulongshan and Xinbaoshan, Paosha, Chengxian, Gansu

summary.zh: 红二方面军在五龙山阻击王均部，毙伤数百、俘敌 300 余。
summary.en: The Second Front Army blocked Wang Jun’s forces at Wulongshan, killing or wounding several hundred and capturing over 300.

description.zh: 1936 年 9 月 25 日，国民党王均部第三十五旅及补充团由武都向成县反扑。9 月 27 日至 29 日，红二方面军以红三十二军和红二军第四师、第六师在成县抛沙五龙山、新堡山设伏阻击。红军第十二团政委杨秀山率一营迂回敌侧后，与正面守军夹击；战斗毙伤敌数百人、俘敌 300 余人，第十八团政委周成宏（一作周盛宏）牺牲，杨秀山负伤。阻击战完成钳制敌军、掩护主力集结的任务，红军随后移师徽县红川。本坐标为五龙山代表点。
description.en: On 25 September 1936 the 35th Brigade and a replacement regiment of Wang Jun’s force counterattacked Chengxian from Wudu. From 27 to 29 September the Second Front Army’s 32nd Army and the 4th and 6th Divisions of the Second Army ambushed and blocked them at Wulongshan and Xinbaoshan in Paosha. Yang Xiushan, political commissar of the 12th Regiment, led a battalion around the enemy flank to attack in conjunction with the front-line defenders. Several hundred enemy troops were killed or wounded and over 300 captured; Zhou Chenghong (also recorded as Zhou Shenghong), political commissar of the 18th Regiment, was killed, and Yang Xiushan was wounded. The blocking action pinned the enemy and covered the main force’s concentration; the Red Army then moved to Hongchuan in Huixian. The coordinate is a representative point at Wulongshan.

aliases.zh: 中共中央西北局洮州会议

place.zh: 甘肃临潭新城（今新城镇）

summary.zh: 中共中央西北局在洮州重申北上，张国焘被迫同意会师。
summary.en: The Northwest Bureau reaffirmed the northward move at Taozhou; Zhang Guotao was forced to agree to the rendezvous.

description.zh: 1936 年 9 月 27 日，中共中央西北局在临潭新城（今新城镇）召开会议，重新研究红四方面军行动方针。朱德再次争取张国焘，徐向前、陈昌浩等表示拥护北上；张国焘被迫同意放弃西进。会议重申岷州会议决定，当日 20 时朱德、张国焘、徐向前、陈昌浩联名电告党中央和红二方面军，表示「决不再改变」。9 月 28 日红四方面军分六路北上，30 日撤离临潭，10 月 9 日在会宁与红一方面军会师。本坐标为临潭新城会址代表点。
description.en: On 27 September 1936 the Northwest Bureau met at Xincheng in Lintan to reconsider the Fourth Front Army’s course. Zhu De again pressed Zhang Guotao; Xu Xiangqian and Chen Changhao supported moving north, and Zhang Guotao was forced to abandon the westward plan. The meeting reaffirmed the Minzhou decision, and at 20:00 that day Zhu De, Zhang Guotao, Xu Xiangqian, and Chen Changhao telegraphed the Central Committee and the Second Front Army that the decision would “never be changed again.” On 28 September the Fourth Front Army moved north in six columns, left Lintan on 30 September, and met the First Front Army at Huining on 9 October. The coordinate is a representative point at the Xincheng site.

aliases.zh: 通渭庄浪静宁会宁战役

place.zh: 甘肃通渭县城（战役终点代表点）
place.en: Tongwei county town, Gansu (representative end point)

summary.zh: 红四方面军执行《通庄静会战役计划》分五个纵队北上，10 月 5 日占领通渭。
summary.en: The Fourth Front Army carried out the Tong–Zhuang–Jing–Hui plan in five columns and took Tongwei on 5 October.

description.zh: 1936 年 9 月 27 日洮州会议否决张国焘西进主张后，9 月 28 日红四方面军发布《通庄静会战役计划》，决定在西兰通道以北阻击胡宗南部，与红一方面军会师后进军宁夏。9 月 29 日总部下达北进命令，30 日起各部分五个纵队由岷州、漳县等地向通渭、庄浪、会宁、静宁地区前进，10 月 5 日占领通渭县城。此役是三大主力会师的直接前奏：红四方面军由此进至会宁一带，红一方面军则以红十五军团骑兵团于 10 月 2 日袭占会宁城接应。战役期间张国焘仍在 9 月 20 日前后下令部队折回西进，经中央连电说服与朱德、徐向前、陈昌浩等抵制，部队才重新北上，故各部队实际出发日期先后不一。本坐标为通渭县城代表点；五个纵队的逐路路线尚未分线建模。
description.en: After the Taozhou meeting on 27 September 1936 rejected Zhang Guotao’s westward plan, the Fourth Front Army issued the Tong–Zhuang–Jing–Hui campaign plan on 28 September: block Hu Zongnan north of the Xi’an–Lanzhou road, then join the First Front Army and move on Ningxia. Headquarters ordered the northward advance on 29 September; from 30 September the army moved in five columns from Minzhou, Zhangxian, and elsewhere toward Tongwei, Zhuanglang, Huining, and Jingning, taking Tongwei county town on 5 October. The campaign was the immediate prelude to the three main forces’ link-up: the Fourth Front Army thereby reached the Huining area, while the First Front Army’s 15th Army Corps cavalry regiment seized Huining town on 2 October to receive it. Around 20 September Zhang Guotao had again ordered a turn back west; only after repeated telegrams from the Centre and resistance from Zhu De, Xu Xiangqian, Chen Changhao and others did the units resume the northward move, so starting dates varied. The coordinate is a representative point at Tongwei county town; the five columns’ separate routes are not yet modelled.

aliases.zh: 红十五军团骑兵团奔袭会宁
aliases.en: 15th Army Corps Cavalry Raid on Huining

place.zh: 甘肃会宁县城（今会师镇）

summary.zh: 红十五军团骑兵团奔袭会宁，两小时内全歼守敌，打开会师接应阵地。
summary.en: The 15th Army Corps cavalry regiment raided Huining and destroyed the garrison within two hours, opening the link-up staging ground.

description.zh: 1936 年 9 月 30 日，红一方面军第十五军团直属骑兵团（团长韦杰、政委夏云飞）由宁夏同心县出发奔袭会宁县城，10 月 2 日凌晨 5 时许到达城北，趁守敌国民党军两个连及地方警兵未备发起猛攻，不到两小时全歼守敌，占领会宁县城，缴获一批武器弹药。从受领任务到攻克县城历时两天、行程 150 余公里（另有 300 余里、32 小时说），仅数人轻伤。此后红十五军团继续向会宁东南前进，控制会宁至静宁沿线要点；红一军团第一师、第二师占领界石铺等地，控制西兰公路 50 余公里地段。会宁城的夺取为 10 月 9 日三大主力会师提供了接应阵地。本坐标为会宁县城代表点。
description.en: On 30 September 1936 the cavalry regiment directly under the First Front Army’s 15th Army Corps (commander Wei Jie, commissar Xia Yunfei) set out from Tongxin in Ningxia to raid Huining town. At about 5 a.m. on 2 October it reached the north of the town and attacked while two KMT companies and local police were still unprepared; within two hours the garrison was destroyed and the town taken, with a large quantity of weapons and ammunition captured. The operation took two days and covered more than 150 km from receipt of orders (some accounts say over 300 li in 32 hours), with only a few lightly wounded. The 15th Army Corps then pushed southeast and controlled the Huining–Jingning line, while the 1st and 2nd Divisions of the 1st Army Corps occupied Jieshipu and other points, controlling over 50 km of the Xi’an–Lanzhou highway. The capture provided the staging ground for the three main forces’ link-up on 9 October. The coordinate is a representative point at Huining county town.

summary.zh: 红六军第十六师夜袭娘娘坝，师长张辉负伤后牺牲。
summary.en: The 16th Division of the Sixth Army raided Niangniangba; division commander Zhang Hui was wounded and died.

description.zh: 1936 年 10 月 4 日，红二方面军分两路北撤，红六军由两当先行动身。10 月 5 日，红六军第十六师进至天水李子园，师长张辉率一个连夜袭娘娘坝，击溃守敌一个营，掩护全军渡过渭河封锁线。张辉在战斗中负重伤，撤至李子园普华寺后牺牲，年仅 25 岁。本坐标为娘娘坝代表点。
description.en: On 4 October 1936 the Second Front Army withdrew north in two columns, the Sixth Army leading from Liangdang. On 5 October the 16th Division reached Ziyuan in Tianshui; division commander Zhang Hui led a company in a night raid on Niangniangba, routed a garrison battalion, and covered the army’s crossing of the Wei River blockade line. Zhang Hui was badly wounded and died at Puhua Monastery in Ziyuan; he was 25. The coordinate is a representative point at Niangniangba.

sources.author: 中共天水市委党史和地方志研究室

sources.title: 《血沃陇原 英魂永驻》
sources.author: 中国甘肃网
sources.note: 用于核对张辉牺牲于李子园、晏福生负伤与渭河渡河损失

place.zh: 甘肃礼县罗家堡龙池湾一带
place.en: Luojiabao and Longchiwan area, Lixian, Gansu

summary.zh: 红六军在罗家堡龙池湾遭两路敌军夹击，第十六师政委晏福生负重伤。
summary.en: The Sixth Army was caught between two enemy columns at Luojiabao–Longchiwan; 16th Division commissar Yan Fusheng was gravely wounded.

description.zh: 1936 年 10 月 7 日，红六军冒雨由天水向礼县前进，途经罗家堡龙池湾一带时突遭两路敌军夹击。红军边打边走，第十六师政委晏福生在战斗中身负重伤，后与部队失散，历尽艰险返回部队并失去右臂。红六军主力突围后继续北上，10 月 8 日与左纵队在礼县固城会合。本坐标为罗家堡、龙池湾一带代表点。
description.en: On 7 October 1936 the Sixth Army marched in rain from Tianshui toward Lixian and was suddenly caught between two enemy columns near Luojiabao and Longchiwan. Fighting as it moved, the army suffered heavy casualties; Yan Fusheng, political commissar of the 16th Division, was gravely wounded, became separated from the unit, and eventually rejoined it after losing his right arm. The main force broke through and continued north, joining the left column at Gucheng in Lixian on 8 October. The coordinate is a representative point in the Luojiabao–Longchiwan area.

place.zh: 甘肃会宁青江驿、静宁界石铺一带

summary.zh: 红四方面军第四军先头部队与红一方面军在青江驿、界石铺会合，揭开三军会师序幕。
summary.en: Advance units of the Fourth Front Army’s 4th Army met the First Front Army at Qingjiangyi and Jieshipu, opening the three-army link-up.

description.zh: 1936 年 10 月 7 日，红四方面军第四军先头部队两个团抵达会宁县城，与红一方面军第十五军团第七十三师会合。10 月 8 日，第四军第十师在会宁青江驿、静宁界石铺等地与红一军团第一师会师。这两次会合早于 10 月 9 日主力入城，被称作三大主力会师的序幕；两军指战员虽连日行军，仍相互握手拥抱。会师后红四方面军总部与第四军、第三十一军于 10 月 9 日进入会宁县城。本坐标为界石铺代表点，青江驿在其西约 20 公里。
description.en: On 7 October 1936 two advance regiments of the Fourth Front Army’s 4th Army reached Huining county town and joined the First Front Army’s 15th Army Corps 73rd Division. On 8 October the 4th Army’s 10th Division met the 1st Army Corps’ 1st Division at Qingjiangyi in Huining and Jieshipu in Jingning. These meetings preceded the main forces’ entry on 9 October and are regarded as the opening of the three-army link-up; despite days of marching, the men embraced one another. The Fourth Front Army headquarters, the 4th Army and the 31st Army then entered Huining town on 9 October. The coordinate is a representative point at Jieshipu; Qingjiangyi lies about 20 km to its west.

aliases.en: Meeting of the Three Main Forces

summary.zh: 红一、红四方面军在会宁会师，10 月 10 日举行庆祝联欢大会；红二方面军随后在将台堡与红一方面军会师。
summary.en: The First and Fourth Front Armies met at Huining and held a celebration on 10 October; the Second Front Army later met the First at Jiangtaibao.

description.zh: 1936 年 10 月 9 日，朱德、张国焘、徐向前、陈昌浩率红军总部和第四军、第三十一军抵达甘肃会宁县城，与红一方面军会合，会宁会师实现。10 月 10 日黄昏，庆祝会师联欢大会在会宁县城文庙大成殿前举行，朱德宣读中共中央《为庆祝一、二、四方面军大会合通电》，通电宣告「我们即刻就要进入一个新阶段了，这就是抗日民族革命战争的阶段」。此前 10 月 7 日第四军先头部队已在会宁与红十五军团第七十三师会合，10 月 8 日第四军第十师在青江驿、界石铺与红一军团第一师会师。10 月 22 日，红二方面军与红一方面军在宁夏西吉将台堡会师，三大主力会师完成，长征胜利结束。本坐标为会宁县城代表点。
description.en: On 9 October 1936 Zhu De, Zhang Guotao, Xu Xiangqian, and Chen Changhao led the Red Army headquarters, the 4th Army, and the 31st Army into Huining county town in Gansu and joined the First Front Army, completing the Huining link-up. At dusk on 10 October a celebration was held before the Dacheng Hall of the Confucian temple in Huining, where Zhu De read the Central Committee’s “Message of Congratulation on the Great Union of the First, Second, and Fourth Front Armies,” which declared that “we are about to enter a new stage — the stage of the national revolutionary war against Japan.” Earlier, on 7 October, advance units of the 4th Army had met the 15th Army Corps’ 73rd Division at Huining, and on 8 October the 4th Army’s 10th Division met the 1st Army Corps’ 1st Division at Qingjiangyi and Jieshipu. On 22 October the Second Front Army met the First at Jiangtaibao in Xiji, Ningxia, completing the union of the three main forces and ending the Long March. The coordinate is a representative point at Huining county town.

aliases.en: Second Front Army Crossing the Wei River

place.zh: 甘肃甘谷磐安镇一带渭河渡口
place.en: Wei River crossings around Pan’an, Gangu, Gansu

summary.zh: 红二方面军在磐安、礼辛一带强渡渭河，摆脱追敌后北上通渭。
summary.en: The Second Front Army forced the Wei River around Pan’an and Lixin, escaped its pursuers, and moved north to Tongwei.

description.zh: 1936 年 10 月 9 日至 11 日，红二方面军左、右纵队在甘谷磐安镇、礼辛镇一带就近选择渡口强渡渭河。时值深秋雨季，上游暴雨致河水暴涨，部分行至河心的指战员被洪水卷走；红军昼夜兼程，于 10 月 11 日在礼辛镇陈家庄一带集结完毕，随后经通渭榜罗镇北上，10 月 22 日到达将台堡与红一方面军会师。贺龙后来总结称「过渭河，狼狈极了」。本坐标为磐安镇渡口代表点。
description.en: From 9 to 11 October 1936 the Second Front Army’s left and right columns forced the Wei River at the nearest crossings around Pan’an and Lixin in Gangu. It was the autumn rainy season; upstream storms raised the river and swept away some men caught midstream. Marching day and night, the army assembled at Chenjiazhuang near Lixin on 11 October, then moved north via Bangluo in Tongwei and reached Jiangtaibao on 22 October to meet the First Front Army. He Long later summed up the crossing as “utterly wretched.” The coordinate is a representative point at the Pan’an crossing.

place.en: Dadunliang, Huajialing, on the Tongwei–Huining border, Gansu

summary.zh: 红五军在华家岭大墩梁阻击敌军，罗南辉与 880 余名指战员牺牲。
summary.en: The Fifth Army blocked the enemy at Dadunliang, Huajialing; Luo Nanhui and over 880 officers and men were killed.

description.zh: 1936 年 10 月，红一、二、四方面军在会宁、静宁地区会师后，国民党王均部、毛炳文部紧追。红五军副军长罗南辉奉命率部在通渭、会宁交界的华家岭大墩梁阻击，他此前已负伤，仍躺在担架上指挥。10 月 22 日至 23 日，红五军在大墩梁与敌军 9 个团激战，敌机 7 架轮番轰炸，红军多次反冲锋未能打退敌军，罗南辉和 880 余名指战员牺牲，完成了掩护主力转移的任务。本坐标为大墩梁代表点。
description.en: In October 1936, after the First, Second, and Fourth Front Armies met at Huining and Jingning, Wang Jun’s and Mao Bingwen’s forces pressed close. Luo Nanhui, deputy commander of the Fifth Army, was ordered to block them at Dadunliang in Huajialing on the Tongwei–Huining border; already wounded, he commanded from a stretcher. On 22–23 October the Fifth Army fought nine enemy regiments at Dadunliang while seven aircraft bombed in relays. Repeated counterattacks failed to drive the enemy back; Luo Nanhui and over 880 officers and men were killed, but the main force was covered in its withdrawal. The coordinate is a representative point at Dadunliang.
